Abbreviation: E-RAB DR RNL eNB
Name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Drop Ratio per Cause RNL
Description: This KPI describes the ratio of a specific E-RAB drop (abnormal release) cause related to all E-RAB releases. Cause: E-RAB drop ratio due to radio network layer (RNL) due to loss of connection to the UE initiated by the eNB.
Official Notes:
1. Each bearer of the "Bearer to be Released List" IE is counted.
2. There is an overlapping in the abnormal E-RABs counted within the LTE_5090d and LTE_5570e but from network planning and optimization point of view it is mandatory to have also an own indicator dealing with active E-RAB drops with data in the buffer only.
3. The formula LTE_5571d is needed to monitor the VoIP Call Drop Ratio.
4. In the denominator of the formula normal and abnormal E-RAB releases except the successful intra LTE and inter RAT HO are counted.
5. E-RAB releases due to S1 RESET are not counted at all.
6. E-RAB releases due to "No Radio Resources Available" initiated by eNB are counted as normal releases as they are not real drops resulted from any radio quality problems.
7. Inter RAT HO to GERAN is excluded from counting on ERAB_REL_HO_PART and ERAB_REL_HO_PART_QCI1 because it is not certain whether the MME will include the E-RAB with QCI#1 into the "E-RABs to Release List". So the restriction is not only in eNB side but also in EPC side.
Logical Formula: E-RAB DRCause = (abnormal E-RAB release request_x / all E-RAB releases) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
100*sum([eNB initiated E-RAB releases due to loss of connection to the UE]) /
sum([Total number of released E-RABs initiated by the eNB] + [E-RABs released due to the partial Handover regardless of the bearers QCI] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Normal release by UE] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Detach procedure by UE or MME] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Radio Network Layer cause] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Other causes] + [EPC initiated E-RAB releases due to Path Switch])
Time Summary Levels: Total; week; weeklyBH; day; dailyBH; hour

Abbreviation: E-RAB DR OTH eNB
Name: E-UTRAN E-RAB drop ratio due to other (OTH) cause initiated by eNB
Description: This KPI indicates the ratio of a specific E-RAB drop (abnormal release) cause to all E-RAB releases. Cause: E-RAB drop ratio due to other (OTH) causes initiated by the eNB
Official Notes:
1. Each bearer of the "Bearer to be Released List" IE is counted.
2. There is an overlapping in the abnormal E-RABs counted within the LTE_5090c and LTE_5570d but from network planning and optimization point of view it is mandatory to have also an own indicator dealing with active E-RAB drops with data in the buffer only.
3. The formula LTE_5571c is needed to monitor the VoIP Call Drop Ratio.
4. In the denominator of the formula normal and abnormal E-RAB releases except the successful intra LTE and inter RAT HO are counted.
5. E-RAB releases due to S1 RESET are not counted at all.
6. E-RAB releases due to "No Radio Resources Available" initiated by eNB are counted as normal releases as they are not real drops resulted from any radio quality problems.
Logical Formula: E-RAB DRCause = (abnormal E-RAB release request_x / all E-RAB releases) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
100*sum([Total number of released E-RABs initiated by the eNB] - [eNB initiated E-RAB releases due to loss of connection to the UE] - [eNB initiated E-RAB releases due to insufficient transport resources] - [E-RABs released due to failed Handover regardless of the bearers QCI] - [eNB initiated E-RAB releases due to user inactivity] - [eNB initiated E-RAB releases due to redirect to another cell] - [eNB initiated E-RAB releases due to E-UTRAN Generated Reason] - [eNB initiated E-RAB releases due to missing radio resources]) /
sum([Total number of released E-RABs initiated by the eNB] + [E-RABs released due to the partial Handover regardless of the bearers QCI] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Normal release by UE] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Detach procedure by UE or MME] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Radio Network Layer cause] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Other causes])
Time Summary Levels: Total; week; weeklyBH; day; dailyBH; hour

([Initial EPS Bearer setup attempts for GBR DRBs of QCI2] + [Additional EPS Bearer setup attempts for GBR DRBs of QCI2]) - ([Initial EPS Bearer setup attempts for GBR DRBs of QCI3] + [Additional EPS Bearer setup attempts for GBR DRBs of QCI3]) - ([Initial EPS Bearer setup attempts for GBR DRBs of QCI4] + [Additional EPS Bearer setup attempts for GBR DRBs of QCI4]))

Logical Formula: RCC Con SSR EMG=(RRC connection setup completions for emergency calls / RRC connection requests for emergency calls)*100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Signaling Connection Establishment completions for emergency calls]) / sum([Number of Signaling Connection Establishment attempts for emergency calls])

Abbreviation: RRC Conn Stp Att, EMG

Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
sum([Number of Signaling Connection Establishment attempts for emergency calls]+
[Signaling Connection Establishment attempts due to others])

Abbreviation: SIGN_CONN_ESTAB_ATT MO-S
Name: RRC Connection Setup Attempts MO Sig
Description: This KPI shows the RRC connection setup attempts on a per cause basis. Cause: MO signalling.
Logical Formula: SIGN_CONN_ESTAB_ATT = SIGN_CONN_ESTAB_ATT_x
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: sum ([Number of Signaling Connection Establishment attempts due to MO-signaling])

Abbreviation: E-RAB DR OTH EPC
Name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Drop Ratio per Cause OTH EPC
Description:
This KPI indicates the ratio of a specific E-RAB drop (abnormal release) cause
to all E-RAB releases. Cause: E-RAB drop ratio due to other (OTH) causes initiated
by EPC.
Official Notes:
1. Each bearer of the "Bearer to be Released List" IE is counted.
2. There is an overlapping in the abnormal E-RABs counted within the LTE_5090d and LTE_5570e but from network planning and optimization point of view it is mandatory to have also an own indicator dealing with active E-RAB drops with data in the buffer only.
3. The formula LTE_5571d is needed to monitor the VoIP Call Drop Ratio.
4. In the denominator of the formula normal and abnormal E-RAB releases except the successful intra LTE and inter RAT HO are counted.
5. E-RAB releases due to S1 RESET are not counted at all.
6. E-RAB releases due to "No Radio Resources Available" initiated by eNB are counted as normal releases as they are not real drops resulted from any radio quality problems.
Logical Formula: E-RAB DRCause = (abnormal E-RAB release request_x / all E-RAB releases) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
100*sum([EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Other causes])
/
sum([Total number of released E-RABs initiated by the eNB] + [E-RABs released due to the partial Handover regardless of the bearers QCI] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Normal release by UE] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Detach procedure by UE or MME] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Radio Network Layer cause] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Other causes] + [EPC initiated E-RAB releases due to Path Switch] - [Temporary QCI1 E-RAB release due to overbooking timer expiry])
Time Summary Levels: Total; week; weeklyBH; day; dailyBH; hour

Abbreviation: E-UTRAN InterRAT HO att
Name: E-UTRAN Inter RAT HO Attempts
Description: This KPI shows the number of inter-RAT handover attempts.
Official Notes: The HOs to eHRPD are not counted in this KPI.
Logical Formula:
Inter RAT HO Att =
(number of inter RAT HO attempts)
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: sum([PS-HO attempts to UTRAN]+[Inter System Handover attempts to UTRAN with SRVCC]+[Inter System Handover attempts to GERAN with SRVCC])

Abbreviation: PDCP SDU Discard Ratio in DL, QCI1
Name: E-UTRAN PDCP SDU Discard Ratio in DL, QCI1
Description: This KPI provides the ratio of the number of discarded to total number of PDCP SDUs in DL per QCI1.
Logical Formula: PDCPSDUDiscRDLQCI1= 100 x (Number of discarded PDCP SDUs in DL per QCI1)/ (Total number of PDCP SDUs in DL per QCI1)
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([PDCP SDU discarded DL QCI 1])/ sum([PDCP SDU DL QCI 1]+[Number of lost PDCP SDUs in DL for QCI 1]+[PDCP SDU discarded DL QCI 1])
Time Summary Levels: Total; week; weeklyBH; day; dailyBH; hour
NetEng Comment:

Abbreviation: PDCP SDU disc R DL, QCI3
Name: E-UTRAN PDCP SDU Discard Ratio in DL, QCI3
Description: This KPI indicates the ratio of the number of discarded to the total number of PDCP SDUs in DL per QCI3.
Official Notes:
1) The measuremenst providing the number of discarded PDCP SDUs are implemented according to 3GPP 36.314 chapter 4.1.5.1.

Logical Formula: PDCPSDUDiscRDLQCI3= 100 x (Number of discarded PDCP SDUs in DL per QCI3)/ (Total number of PDCP SDUs in DL per QCI3)
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([PDCP SDU discarded DL QCI 3])/ sum([PDCP SDU DL QCI 3]+[Number of lost PDCP SDUs in DL for QCI 3]+[PDCP SDU discarded DL QCI 3])

Abbreviation: Avg PRB usage per TTI UL
Name: E-UTRAN Average PRB usage per TTI UL
Description: This KPI shows the average value of the physical resource block (PRB) utilization per TTI in an uplink direction. The utilization is defined by the ratio of used to available PRBs per TTI.

Abbreviation: Penetr CA capab UEs in Nw
Name: E-UTRAN Penetration of the CA Capable UEs into the Network
Description: This KPI shows the ratio of the averaged number of the CA capable UEs and average number of UEs in RRC_CONNECTED state.
Official Notes: The indicator together with the LTE_5318a is used to help to operator on the decision to enable/disable the CA feature.

Abbreviation: Avg SINR per cell PUCCH
Name: E-UTRAN Average SINR per Cell for PUCCH
Description: This KPI shows the signal-to-interference-and-noise ratio (SINR) measured in the eNB for a physical UL control channel (PUCCH) per cell.
Logical Formula: AVG SINR Cell PUCCH= average of measured SINR values for PUCCH per Cell
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: avg([Mean of cell-wide SINR on PUCCH])

Abbreviation: CGI reports SR
Name: E-UTRAN CGI reports for E-UTRAN Success Ratio
Description: This KPI indicates the ratio of successful attempts to all attempts to retrieve the cell global identifier (CGI) of a neighbor cell from the UE.
Official Notes: This indicator is used to monitor the correctness of the ANR to E-UTRAN behavior. The CGI retrieval is applicable to intra-frequency and inter-frequency.
Logical Formula: CGISuccRatio =( Number of Succ CGI Reports)/( Number of CGI Req Reports)x100
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100* sum([Number of successful CGI Reports])/sum([Number of Report CGI Requests])

Abbreviation: X2 IP add retriv att

Abbreviation: Cell res grp 4 util R UL
Name: E-UTRAN Cell Resource Group 4 Utilization Ratio in UL
Description: This KPI shows the cell resource group 4 utilization ratio in UL defined as the ratio of TTIs used by the cell resource group 4 to the total number of TTIs available in UL.
Official Notes: Up to four resource groups can be configured per cell with UEs' selection according to PLMN ids. One of the resource groups is default one covering unassigned PLMN ids. One group my cover multiple PLMN ids but one PLMN ids cannot be assigned to multiple resource groups.
Logical Formula: CellResG4UL=( Used TTIs by cell group 4 in UL/Total Number of TTIs in UL)
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([TTIs used in UL by cell resource group 4])/ sum([Number of available TTIs for PUSCH])
Comments: 22.12.2023 - Typo in Official notes corrected. (24R2/18PMO/Hidden). M.Goral

Abbreviation: E-UTRAN Avg CQI Offset
Name: E-UTRAN Average CQI Offset
Description: This KPI shows the average eNB used offset (correction) value for Channel Quality Indicators (CQI)
Logical Formula: AVG CQI Offset= average of measured CQI offset values
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: avg([CQI offset Mean])
Formula Notes:
Note 1: When using the formula, linear scale has to be used with calculations. This means that the dBm values in the counters must be converted to Watts and after the calculation is done, the result must be converted back to dBms.
P[dBm]=10*lg(P1/1mW)
P1= 10^(P[dBm]/10)*1mW
Time Summary Levels: Total; week; weeklyBH; day; dailyBH; hour

Abbreviation: E-UTRAN nonGBR E-RAB ret RAN v, RNL fail
Name: E-UTRAN non GBR E-RAB Retainability Rate, RAN View, RNL Failure with UE Lost

Abbreviation: Avg nr Paired UEs UL UM-MIMO

/
sum ([Inter System Handover preparations to 1xRTT with SRVCC])

Summarisation Formula with NE Name: Avg([RACH initial preamble target power])
Time Summary Levels: Total; week; weeklyBH; day; dailyBH; hour

Abbreviation: Act time dist R 0/1 sat links GNSSE
Name: Active time distribution ratio with 0 or 1 GNSSE satellite links
Description: The KPIs indicates the ratio of seconds within the collection period for 0 or 1 GNSSE satellite links that are available to whole measurement period duration.

1) GNSS satellites are currently represented by GPS and GLONASS system components.
2) GNSSE is meant by external GNSS.
Logical Formula: Active time distribution ratio with 0 or 1 GNSSE sat links = (Time within 0 or 1 GNSS usable satellites condition) / (active cell time)
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100* sum([Time within 0 or 1 GNSS usable satellites condition for external GNSS]) / sum([Denominator for RRC Connected UEs per cell])

Good quality signal is when more than 5 satellites with good signal level are usable.
At least 4 usable satellites are required to generate synchronization signal in automatic location mode

Abbreviation: Act time dist R 0/1 sat links GNSSI FZAP

= (number of inter eNB S1 based HO attempts for QCI1 to a Home eNB cell) / (total number of inter eNB S1 based HO preparations for QCI1 to a Home eNB cell) * 100%

Abbreviation: ERAB DR Cat-M UEs cause other init eNB
Name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Drop Ratio per Cause for Cat-M UEs, E-RAB drop ratio due to other (OTH) cause initiated be eNB
Description: This KPI describes the ratio of a specific E-RAB drop (abnormal release) cause related to all E-RAB releases for Cat-M UEs.
Official Notes:
1. Each bearer of the "Bearer to be Released List" IE is counted. 
2. E-RAB releases due to "No Radio Resources Available" initiated by eNB are counted as normal releases from RAN perspective as they are not real drops resulted from any radio quality problems.
3. All Initial and Additional E-RABs are being counted within Retainability KPIs.
4. E-RAB releases due to double S1 for Cat-M UEs  which are counted within the ERAB_REL_DS1_LTEM are considered as normal releases from end user perspective. Typical scenario such a case may happen is  when VoLTE call (a session in general)  is ongoing, UE  losses synchronization and send RRC reestablishment on an unprepared target cell which will send RRC reestablishment rejection to UE. UE will go to idle state and send new RRC request on target cell. When MME receives service request via target cell, it will already have UE context from source cell  (T_RLF still not expired at source cell) so will send UE context release command (RNL UE connectivity lost cause).
Logical Formula: E-RAB DRCause Cat-M = (abnormal E-RAB release request_x / all E-RAB releases) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
(100*sum([Total number of released E-RABs initiated by the eNB for LTE-M] - [eNB initiated E-RAB releases due to user inactivity for LTE-M] - [eNB initiated E-RAB releases due to missing radio resources for LTE-M] - [eNB initiated E-RAB releases due to insufficient transport resources for LTE-M] - [eNB initiated E-RAB releases due to loss of connection to the UE for LTE-M]) / 
sum([Total number of released E-RABs initiated by the eNB for LTE-M] + [E-RAB Releases due to the partial handover for LTE-M] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Normal release by UE for LTE-M] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Detach procedure by UE or MME for LTE-M] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Radio Network Layer cause for LTE-M] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Other causes for LTE-M] + [EPC initiated E-RAB releases due to the Path Switch] + [E-RAB Releases due to the timer TX2RELOCcomp expiry at target eNB via RRC Connection Release for LTE-M.] + [Number of E-RAB releases due to eNB-initiated Global S1 Reset for LTE-M] + [Number of E-RAB releases due to MME-initiated Global S1 Reset for LTE-M] + [Number of E-RAB releases due to eNB-initiated Partial S1 Reset for LTE-M] + [Number of E-RAB releases due to MME-initiated Partial S1 Reset for LTE-M] + [Number of E-RAB releases due to S1 Outage for LTE-M]))
Time Summary Levels: Month; monthBH; week; weekBH; day; dayBH; hour; raw

Abbreviation: Activ ERAB DR Cat-M UEs data buffer RNL UE lost  init eNB

Description: This KPI describes the ratio of a specific E-RAB drop (abnormal release) cause related to all E-RAB releases for Cat-M UEs. Cause: E-RAB active drop ratio with data in the buffer due to RNL Radio Connection with UE Lost cause initiated by eNB.
Official Notes:
1. Each bearer of the "Bearer to be Released List" IE is counted. 
2. E-RAB releases due to "No Radio Resources Available" initiated by eNB are counted as normal releases from RAN perspective as they are not real drops resulted from any radio quality problems.
3. All Initial and Additional E-RABs are being counted within Retainability KPIs.
4. S1 reset related counters are not counted within this KPI at all.
5. E-RAB releases due to double S1 for Cat-M UEs  which are counted within the ERAB_REL_DS1_LTEM are considered as normal releases from end user perspective. Typical scenario such a case may happen is  when VoLTE call (a session in general)  is ongoing, UE  losses synchronization and send RRC reestablishment on an unprepared target cell which will send RRC reestablishment rejection to UE. UE will go to idle state and send new RRC request on target cell. When MME receives service request via target cell, it will already have UE context from source cell  (T_RLF still not expired at source cell) so will send UE context release command (RNL UE connectivity lost cause).
Logical Formula: E-RAB DRCause Cat-M = (abnormal E-RAB release request_x / all E-RAB releases) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
100*sum([Released active non GBR E-RABs (QCI5...9) (LTE-M)]) / 
sum([Total number of released E-RABs initiated by the eNB for LTE-M] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Normal release by UE for LTE-M] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Detach procedure by UE or MME for LTE-M] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Radio Network Layer cause for LTE-M] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Other causes for LTE-M] + [Number of E-RAB releases due to eNB-initiated Global S1 Reset for LTE-M] + [Number of E-RAB releases due to MME-initiated Global S1 Reset for LTE-M] + [Number of E-RAB releases due to eNB-initiated Partial S1 Reset for LTE-M] + [Number of E-RAB releases due to MME-initiated Partial S1 Reset for LTE-M] + [Number of E-RAB releases due to S1 Outage for LTE-M])

Abbreviation: Perc SCell Conf Att Traffic Load Rej
Name: E-UTRAN Percentage of Rejected SCell Configuration Attempts due to Traffic Load

Official Notes: The KPI shall help operators to monitor percentage of internally rejected SCell configuration attempts due to traffic load which shall avoid further increase of downlink load related to new admitted carrier aggregation guest UE contexts.
Logical Formula: Perc SCellCongATT TrafficLoadRej = (Number of internally rejected SCell configuration attempts due to traffic load / Number of load based SCell blocking conditions checks) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Number of SCell configurations blocked due to traffic load]) / sum([Number of Load Based SCell configuration checks])

Abbreviation: Avg RSSI per cell PUCCH
Name: E-UTRAN Average RSSI per Cell for PUCCH
Description: This KPI shows the average Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) value measured in the eNB for a physical UL control channel (PUCCH) per cell and normalized per the number of PRBs applicable to PUCCH.
Official Notes:
When using the formula, linear scale has to be used with calculations. This means that the dBm values in the counters must be converted to Watts and after the calculation is done, the result must be converted back to dBms.
Aggregation of dBm values:
P[dBm]=10*lg(P1/1mW)
P1= 10^(P[dBm]/10)*1mW
Logical Formula: AVG RSSI Cell PUCCH= average of measured RSSI values for PUCCH per Cell
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: avg( [Mean of cell-wide RSSI on PUCCH])

Summarisation Formula with NE Name: avg( [Mean of cell-wide SINR on PUSCH])

Description: This KPI indicates the ratio of failed inter-RAT handovers to eHRPD caused by an expiration of guarding timer TC2KRelocOverallHRPD to all attempted inter-RAT handovers to eHRPD. This KPI represents the case of a failed handover when all UE resources are still allocated to the UE.
Official Notes: The KPI provides a total ratio aggregated over all configured eHRPD bandclasses.
Logical Formula: Inter RAT HO eHRPD FR =(number of unsuccessful inter RAT HOs to eHRPD) / (number of inter RAT HO attempts to eHRPD)*100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Failed Inter System Handover attempts to eHRPD caused by expiration of guarding timer TC2KRelocOverallHRPD per eHRPD bandclass]) / sum([Inter System Handover attempts to eHRPD per eHRPD bandclass])

Abbreviation: IRAT HO eHRPD tot SR
Name: E-UTRAN Inter RAT Total HO to eHRPD Success Ratio
Description: This KPI indicates the total inter-RAT HO success to eHRPD ratio from an HO preparation start until a successful HO execution.
Official Notes: The KPI provides a total ratio aggregated over all configured eHRPD bandclasses.
Logical Formula:
Inter RAT tot HO eHRPD SR=
(inter RAT HO eHRPD successes) / (inter RAT HO preparations to eHRPD)*100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100* sum([Successful Inter System Handover completions to eHRPD per eHRPD bandclass])/ sum([Inter System Handover preparations to eHRPD per eHRPD bandclass])

Abbreviation: E-RAB DR
Name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Drop Ratio, RAN View
Description: This KPI describes the ratio of abnormally released (dropped) E-RABs from RAN point of view.
Official Notes:
1) Each bearer of the Bearer to be Released List IE is counted. 
2) RAN point of view means that as abnormal E-RAB drops only those ones initiated by eNB are counted.
3) E-RAB releases due to No Radio Resources Available initiated by eNB are counted as normal releases as they are not real drops resulted from any radio quality problems.

Abbreviation: E-RAB DR RNL
Name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Drop Ratio per Cause RNL
Description:
This KPI describes the ratio of a specific E-RAB drop (abnormal
release) cause related to all E-RAB release commands.
E-RAB drop ratio due to Radio Network Layer
(RNL) cause initiated by eNB
Official Notes:
1. Each bearer of the "Bearer to be Released List" IE is counted.
2. There is an overlapping in the abnormal E-RABs counted within the LTE_5090a and LTE_5570b but from network planning and optimization point of view it is mandatory to have also an own indicator dealing with active E-RAB drops with data in the buffer only.
3. The formula LTE_5571a is needed to monitor the VoIP Call Drop Ratio.
4. In the denominator of the formula normal and abnormal E-RAB releases except the successful intra LTE and inter RAT HO are counted.
5. E-RAB releases due to S1 RESET are not counted at all.
6. E-RAB releases due to "No Radio Resources Available" initiated by eNB are counted as normal releases as they are not real drops resulted from any radio quality problems.
7. The PRE_EMPT_GBR_BEARER and PRE_EMPT_NON_GBR_BEARER counters provide the total number of released GBR and non GBR E-RABs due to "Radio resources not available" despite a pre-emption used in the counter names, respectively.
8. The LTE_5571a KPI may provide slightly worse results as the E-RAB releases due to "No Radio Resources Available" initiated by eNB are not counted in denominator of the formula.
Logical Formula:
100*sum([ENB_EPS_BEARER_REL_REQ_RNL]) /
sum([EPC_EPS_BEARER_REL_REQ_NORM]+
[EPC_EPS_BEARER_REL_REQ_DETACH]+
[EPC_EPS_BEARER_REL_REQ_RNL]+
[EPC_EPS_BEARER_REL_REQ_OTH]+
[ENB_EPSBEAR_REL_REQ_RNL_REDIR]+
[ENB_EPS_BEARER_REL_REQ_NORM] +
[ENB_EPS_BEARER_REL_REQ_RNL]+
[ENB_EPS_BEARER_REL_REQ_TNL]+
[ENB_EPS_BEARER_REL_REQ_OTH]+
[PRE_EMPT_GBR_BEARER]+ [PRE_EMPT_NON_GBR_BEARER])
Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
100*sum([Released E-RABs initiated by the eNB due to Radio Link Failure]) /
sum([EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Normal release by UE]+
[EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Detach procedure by UE or MME]+
[EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Radio Network Layer cause]+
[EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Other causes]+
[Released E-RABs initiated by the eNB due to Redirect]+
[Released E-RABs initiated by the eNB due to User Inactivity] +
[Released E-RABs initiated by the eNB due to Radio Link Failure]+
[eNB initiated E-RAB releases due to failed Handover Completion phase at target cell]+
[Released E-RABs initiated by the eNB due to other reasons]+
[Pre-empted GBR bearers]+
[Pre-empted non-GBR bearers])
Formula Notes:
1. Each bearer of the "Bearer to be Released List" IE is counted excepting the formula LTE_5570b and LTE_5571a (QCI1) where as abnormal releases only those E-RABs with data in any buffer are counted.
2. There is an overlapping in the abnormal E-RABs counted within the LTE_5090a and LTE_5570b but from network planning and optimization point of view it is mandatory to have also an own indicator dealing with active E-RAB drops with data in the buffer only.
3. The formula LTE_5571a is needed to monitor the VoIP Call Drop Ratio.
4. In the denominator of the formulae normal and abnormal E-RAB releases except the successful intra LTE and inter RAT HO are counted.
5. E-RAB releases due to S1 RESET are not counted at all.
6. E-RAB releases due to "No Radio Resources Available" initiated by eNB are counted as normal releases as they are not real drops resulted from any radio quality problems.
7. The PRE_EMPT_GBR_BEARER and PRE_EMPT_NON_GBR_BEARER counters provide the total number of released GBR and non GBR E-RABs due to "Radio resources not available" despite a pre-emption used in the counter names, respectively.
8. The LTE_5571a KPI may provide slightly worse results as the E-RAB releases due to "No Radio Resources Available" initiated by eNB are not counted in denominator of the formula.

Abbreviation: Graceful Cell Shutdown DR
Name: E-UTRAN Graceful Cell Shutdown Drop Rate
Description: This KPI describes the ratio of the number of released UE context due to S1AP Partial Resets to the total number of UEs before start of graceful cell shutdown. Different indicators distinguish between the active and RRC connected UEs.
Logical Formula: GCST DR x =( UE CONT REL S1 reset x/ UE before GCST)*100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Active UE Contexts released due to S1 Reset messages (partial and global) initiated by the eNB] + [Active UE Contexts released due to S1 Reset messages (partial and global) initiated by MME]) / sum([Active UE per Cell average])
Formula Notes:
The KPI is used to monitor Graceful Cell Shutdown feature which is used to empty the cell from UEs whenever the cell of an eNodeB shall be deactivated e.g. to execute service tasks. The UEs are motivated to leave the cell by stepwise reduction of the eNodeB cell TX power. After the power reduction procedure is completed the eNB will execute a S1 Partial Reset. Then the remaining UE connections (e.g. located in the center of the cell) will be released. 

The graceful shutdown feature in connection to S1 partial reset works correctly the indicator shall provide the values close to zero. It should be noted that the assumption here is that during the measurement period an additional Reset procedure beside the graceful cell shutdown won't be initiated otherwise a proper counting isn't possible anyway since a UE may be affected by graceful cell shutdown and additional reset procedures.

Then the remaining UE connections (e.g. located in the center of the cell) will be released. 
2. In case the graceful shutdown feature in connection to S1 partial reset is working correctly the indicator shall provide the values close to zero. It should be noted that the assumption here is that during the measurement period an additional Reset procedure beside the graceful cell shutdown won't be initiated otherwise a proper counting isn't possible anyway since a UE may be affected by graceful cell shutdown and additional reset procedures.
Logical Formula: GCST DR x =( UE CONT REL S1 reset x/ UE before GCST)*100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
100*sum([Active UE Contexts released due to S1 Reset messages (partial and global) initiated by the eNB] + [Active UE Contexts released due to S1 Reset messages (partial and global) initiated by MME]) /
(sum([Sum of active UEs per eNB])/sum([Denominator for active UEs per eNB]))

Abbreviation: Total Graceful Cell Shutdown DR
Name: Total E-UTRAN Graceful Cell Shutdown Drop Rate
Description: This KPI indicates the ratio of UE contexts released due to S1AP Partial Resets to the total number of UEs before the start of a graceful cell shutdown. Different indicators distinguish between the active and RRC-connected UEs.
Official Notes:
1. The KPI is used to monitor Graceful Cell Shutdown feature which is used to empty the cell from UEs whenever the cell of an eNodeB shall be deactivated e.g. to execute service tasks. The UEs are motivated to leave the cell by stepwise reduction of the eNodeB cell TX power. After the power reduction procedure is completed the eNB will execute a S1 Partial Reset. Then the remaining UE connections (e.g. located in the center of the cell) will be released. 
2. In case the graceful shutdown feature in connection to S1 partial reset is working correctly the indicator shall provide the values close to zero. It should be noted that the assumption here is that during the measurement period an additional Reset procedure beside the graceful cell shutdown won't be initiated otherwise a proper counting isn't possible anyway since a UE may be affected by graceful cell shutdown and additional reset procedures.
Logical Formula: GCST DR x =( UE CONT REL S1 reset x/ UE before GCST)*100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([UE Contexts released due to S1 Reset messages (partial and global) initiated by the eNB] + [UE Contexts released due to S1 Reset messages (partial and global) initiated by MME]) / (sum([Sum of RRC Connected UEs per cell])/sum([Denominator for RRC Connected UEs per cell]))

Abbreviation: Total Graceful Cell Shutdown DR
Name: E-UTRAN Total Graceful Cell Shutdown Drop Rate
Description: This KPI describes the ratio of the number of released UE context due to S1AP Partial Resets to the total number of UEs before start of graceful cell shutdown. Different indicators distinguish between the active and RRC connected UEs.
Official Notes:
1. The KPI is used to monitor Graceful Cell Shutdown feature which is used to empty the cell from UEs whenever the cell of an eNodeB shall be deactivated e.g. to execute service tasks. The UEs are motivated to leave the cell by stepwise reduction of the eNodeB cell TX power. After the power reduction procedure is completed the eNB will execute a S1 Partial Reset. Then the remaining UE connections (e.g. located in the center of the cell) will be released.
2. In case the graceful shutdown feature in connection to S1 partial reset is working correctly the indicator shall provide the values close to zero. It should be noted that the assumption here is that during the measurement period an additional Reset procedure beside the graceful cell shutdown won't be initiated otherwise a proper counting isn't possible anyway since a UE may be affected by graceful cell shutdown and additional reset procedures.
Logical Formula: GCST DR x = (UE CONT REL S1 reset x / UE before GCST) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([UE Contexts released due to S1 Reset messages (partial and global) initiated by the eNB] + [UE Contexts released due to S1 Reset messages (partial and global) initiated by MME]) / (sum([Sum of RRC-connected UEs per cell]) /sum([Denominator for RRC-connected UEs per cell]))
Formula Notes:
Both sum([SUM_ACTIVE_UE_ENB] / [DENOM_ACTIVE_UE_ENB])
and sum([SUM_RRC_CONNECTED_UE] / [DENOM_RRC_CONNECTED_UE]) shall be taken from representative measurement periods (e.g. measurement period before cell shutdown) . As an indicator the graceful shutdown and consequent S1 partial reset done or not the Suspect Flag can be used. If the "Suspect Flag" functionality is available the performance measurement data shall be marked as "suspect" after the administrative state changed to shutdown.
Time Summary Levels: Total; week; weeklyBH; day; dailyBH; hour

Abbreviation: E-RAB Stp SR, QCI1
Name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Setup Success Ratio, QCI1
Description: The KPI indicates the setup success ratio of the elementary E-RAB setup procedure used to set up the E-RAB between MME and UE for QCI1 DRBs. It indicates E-UTRAN contribution to the network accessibility for the end user, not the whole end-to-end service accessibility.
Official Notes:
a. For those E-RABs that were temporarily admitted by the eNB and later were released due to overbooking timer expiry are excluded from the nominator of the AdditionalE-RABSetupSuccRate, because they were never used to hand the call over to UTRAN. The setup retry attempts related to additional E-RABs of QCI1 that failed due to ongoing mobility event and also the first setup attempts that failed due to ongoing mobility event  but were followed finally by successful RLF recovery via X2 or S1 (when setup procedure according to 3GPP TS 23.401 shall be done again in target cell) are removed from the denominator of the formula and only first attempts perceived by end user are counted.
b. LTE_5204d may give over-realistic values in high quality networks, where results for E-RAB Normal Releases are near 100% and may sometimes be skipped from one measurement time interval to another, this issue may be even experienced as an avalanche which means it may influence more than 2 intervals (up to infinity). So customer may experience such situation in MT1 100%, MT2 100,05%, MT3 100% ... MT45 99,95%. In such case it is suggested to use LTE_5204c formula where repetitions of E-RAB Setup are counted and there is no subtraction of aborted setup attempt due to mobility, which gives a solid argument that denominator shall almost always be higher than numerator and will very rarely pass 100% due to counting in different measurement time intervals.
Logical Formula: E-RAB SSR QCI1 = (E-RAB setup successes QCI1 / E-RAB setup attempts QCI1) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100 * sum([Successfully established initial E-RABs of QCI1] + [Successfully established additional E-RABs of QCI1] - [Temporary QCI1 E-RAB release due to overbooking timer expiry]) / sum([Number of setup attempts for initial E-RABs of QCI1] +[Setup attempts for additional E-RABs of QCI1 excluding MME retries] - [Setup attempts for additional E-RABs of QCI1 aborted, followed by successful X2/S1 HO or RLF recovery over X2])
Time Summary Levels: Month; monthBH; week; weekBH; day; dayBH; hour; raw
Comments: 02.11.2023 - KPI Subclass, Positive trend and Focus Area fields completed. (24R1/23R1/hidden). M.Goral

Description: This KPI indicates the ratio of a specific E-RAB drop (abnormal release) cause to all E-RAB releases; E-RAB drop ratio due to the radio network layer (RNL) cause initiated by EPC.
Official Notes:
1. Each bearer of the "Bearer to be Released List" IE is counted.
2. There is an overlapping in the abnormal E-RABs counted within the LTE_5090c and LTE_5570d but from network planning and optimization point of view it is mandatory to have also an own indicator dealing with active E-RAB drops with data in the buffer only.
3. The formula LTE_5571c is needed to monitor the VoIP Call Drop Ratio.
4. In the denominator of the formula normal and abnormal E-RAB releases except the successful intra LTE and inter RAT HO are counted.
5. E-RAB releases due to S1 RESET are not counted at all.
6. E-RAB releases due to "No Radio Resources Available" initiated by eNB are counted as normal releases as they are not real drops resulted from any radio quality problems.
Logical Formula: E-RAB DRCause = (abnormal E-RAB release request_x / all E-RAB releases) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
100*sum([EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Radio Network Layer cause]) /
sum([Total number of released E-RABs initiated by the eNB] + [E-RABs released due to the partial Handover regardless of the bearers QCI] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Normal release by UE] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Detach procedure by UE or MME] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Radio Network Layer cause] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Other causes])
Time Summary Levels: Total; week; weeklyBH; day; dailyBH; hour

Abbreviation: Avg RSRP
Name: E-UTRAN Average RSRP
Description: This KPI shows the average Reference Signal Received Power (RSRP) measured and reported by UE according to 3GPP TS 36.133.
Official Notes:
- This KPI provides average RSRP per UE.
- When using the formula, linear scale has to be used with calculations. This means that the dBm values in the configured thresholds (e.g. cfgrsrpmin + cfgrsrpbinsize/2 for bin 2) must be converted to Watts and after the calculation is done, the result must be converted back to dBms. Conversion formulae are given as follows:
P[dBm]=10 * log(P[W] / 1mW)
P[W] = 10^(P[dBm] / 10) * 1mW

Cfgrsrpmin,  cfgrsrpbinsize parameters can be found under MOC PMRPQH either on eNB BTS SM / SCF file / NetAct
Logical Formula: AVG RSRP = average of measured RSRP samples
Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
Sum([Number of RSRQ measurements bin1] *cfgrsrqmin
+[Number of RSRQ measurements bin2] *(cfgrsrqmin+cfgrsrqbinsize/2)
+[Number of RSRQ measurements bin3] *(cfgrsrqmin+3*cfgrsrqbinsize/2)
+[Number of RSRQ measurements bin4] *(cfgrsrqmin+5*cfgrsrqbinsize/2)
+[Number of RSRQ measurements bin5] *(cfgrsrqmin+7*cfgrsrqbinsize/2)
+[Number of RSRQ measurements bin6] *(cfgrsrqmin+9*cfgrsrqbinsize/2)
+[Number of RSRQ measurements bin7] *(cfgrsrqmin+11*cfgrsrqbinsize/2)
+[Number of RSRQ measurements bin8] *(cfgrsrqmin+13*cfgrsrqbinsize/2)
+[Number of RSRQ measurements bin9] *(cfgrsrqmin+15*cfgrsrqbinsize/2)

It shall be noted that the nonGBR group represents a mixture of the services with low (QCI5, QCI7, QCI8 and QCI9) and higher acceptable packet loss rate (QCI7) and therefore to count them in a common indicator addresses the LTE_5309a and LTE_5315a to be used only as indicators of an extreme bahviour. 2.	The cell available  state incorporates the cell in reduced TX power saving mode state.
Logical Formula: CELL AVR PLMN = (time of cell is available for services) / (total measured time ) =(number of samples when cell is available) / (number of all samples)
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Samples when the cell is available per PLMN-ID]) / sum([Cell availability denominator per PLMN-ID])

Abbreviation: Act E-RAB DR RNL
Name: E-UTRAN E-RAB active drop ratio with data in the buffer due to RNL Radio Connection with UE Lost.
Description: This KPI describes the drop ratio of E-RABs with data in the buffer due to RNL Radio Connection with UE Lost cause initiated by eNB.
Official Notes:
1. Each bearer of the "Bearer to be Released List" IE is counted.
2. There is an overlapping in the abnormal E-RABs counted within the LTE_5090a and LTE_5570b but from network planning and optimization point of view it is mandatory to have also an own indicator dealing with active E-RAB drops with data in the buffer only.
3. The formula LTE_5571a is needed to monitor the VoIP Call Drop Ratio.
4. In the denominator of the formula normal and abnormal E-RAB releases except the successful intra LTE and inter RAT HO are counted.
5. E-RAB releases due to S1 RESET are not counted at all.
6. E-RAB releases due to "No Radio Resources Available" initiated by eNB are counted as normal releases as they are not real drops resulted from any radio quality problems.
7. The PRE_EMPT_GBR_BEARER and PRE_EMPT_NON_GBR_BEARER counters provide the total number of released GBR and non GBR E-RABs due to "Radio resources not available" despite a pre-emption used in the counter names, respectively.
8. The LTE_5571a KPI may provide slightly worse results as the E-RAB releases due to "No Radio Resources Available" initiated by eNB are not counted in denominator of the formula.
Logical Formula:
100*sum([ERAB_REL_ENB_ACT_QCI1]+[ERAB_REL_ENB_ACT_QCI2]+[ERAB_REL_ENB_ACT_QCI3]+[ERAB_REL_ENB_ACT_QCI4]+[ERAB_REL_ENB_ACT_NON_GBR])/

Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
100*sum([Released active E-RABs QCI1]+[Released active E-RABs QCI2]+[Released active E-RABs QCI3]+[Released active E-RABs QCI4]+[Released active non GBR E-RABs (QCI5...9)])/
sum([EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Normal release by UE]+[EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Detach procedure by UE or MME]+[EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Radio Network Layer cause]+[EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Other causes]+[Released E-RABs initiated by the eNB due to Redirect]+[Released E-RABs initiated by the eNB due to User Inactivity]+[Released E-RABs initiated by the eNB due to Radio Link Failure]+[eNB initiated E-RAB releases due to failed Handover Completion phase at target cell]+[Released E-RABs initiated by the eNB due to other reasons]+[Pre-empted GBR bearers]+[Pre-empted non-GBR bearers])

Abbreviation: Avg prefer PRBs per TTI DL
Name: E-UTRAN Average Number of Preferred PRBs per TTI DL
Description: This KPI shows the average number of preferred physical resource blocks (PRBs) per TTI where DL interference shaping is applied.
Official Notes: The main objective of the DL interference shaping feature is to make the interference in DL being generated in a fractionally loaded cell more predictable (i.e. more static) to schedule UEs in the highload neighbouring cell being affected by interference in an area with less interference. This KPI is used to monitor the average number of preferred PRBs in the area the UEs in the fractionally loaded cell shall be preferably scheduled.
Logical Formula: AVG DL Preferred PRBs= (Number of preferred PRBs DL)/(Number of TTIs where DL interference shaping is applied)
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: sum([Amount of preferred resources per TTI])/sum([DL interference shaping usage])

Abbreviation: E-RAB DR, EUTRAN reas init eNB

Description: This KPI indicates the ratio of a specific E-RAB drop (abnormal release) cause to all E-RAB releases. Cause: E-RAB drop ratio due to an E-UTRAN-generated reason initiated by an eNB.
Official Notes:
1. Each bearer of the "Bearer to be Released List" IE is counted.
2. There is an overlapping in the abnormal E-RABs counted within the LTE_5090c and LTE_5570d but from network planning and optimization point of view it is mandatory to have also an own indicator dealing with active E-RAB drops with data in the buffer only.
3. The formula LTE_5571c is needed to monitor the VoIP Call Drop Ratio.
4. In the denominator of the formula normal and abnormal E-RAB releases except the successful intra LTE and inter RAT HO are counted.

Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
100*sum([eNB initiated E-RAB releases due to E-UTRAN Generated Reason]) /
sum([Total number of released E-RABs initiated by the eNB] + [E-RABs released due to the partial Handover regardless of the bearers QCI] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Normal release by UE] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Detach procedure by UE or MME] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Radio Network Layer cause] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Other causes])

Description: This KPI indicates the ratio of a specific E-RAB drop (abnormal release) cause to all E-RAB releases. Cause: E-RAB drop ratio due to a partial handover.
Official Notes:
1. Each bearer of the "Bearer to be Released List" IE is counted.
2. There is an overlapping in the abnormal E-RABs counted within the LTE_5090d and LTE_5570e but from network planning and optimization point of view it is mandatory to have also an own indicator dealing with active E-RAB drops with data in the buffer only.
3. The formula LTE_5571d is needed to monitor the VoIP Call Drop Ratio.
4. In the denominator of the formula normal and abnormal E-RAB releases except the successful intra LTE and inter RAT HO are counted.
5. E-RAB releases due to S1 RESET are not counted at all.
6. E-RAB releases due to "No Radio Resources Available" initiated by eNB are counted as normal releases as they are not real drops resulted from any radio quality problems.
7. Inter RAT HO to GERAN is excluded from counting on ERAB_REL_HO_PART and ERAB_REL_HO_PART_QCI1 because it is not certain whether the MME will include the E-RAB with QCI#1 into the "E-RABs to Release List". So the restriction is not only in eNB side but also in EPC side.
Logical Formula: E-RAB DRCause = (abnormal E-RAB release request_x / all E-RAB releases) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
100*sum([E-RABs released due to the partial Handover regardless of the bearers QCI]) /
sum([Total number of released E-RABs initiated by the eNB] + [E-RABs released due to the partial Handover regardless of the bearers QCI] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Normal release by UE] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Detach procedure by UE or MME] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Radio Network Layer cause] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Other causes] + [EPC initiated E-RAB releases due to Path Switch])
Time Summary Levels: Total; week; weeklyBH; day; dailyBH; hour

Abbreviation: E-RAB DR, partial HO
Name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Drop Ratio per Cause partial handover
Description: This KPI describes the ratio of a specific E-RAB drop (abnormal release) cause related to all E-RAB releases. Cause: E-RAB drop ratio due to due to partial handover cause.
Official Notes:
1) Each bearer of the Bearer to be Released List IE is counted. 
2) There is an overlapping in the abnormal E-RABs counted within the LTE_5090f and LTE_5570g but from network planning and optimization point of view it is mandatory to have also an own indicator dealing with active E-RAB drops with data in the buffer only.
3) The formula LTE_5571f is needed to monitor the VoIP Call Drop Ratio.
4) E-RAB releases due to No Radio Resources Available initiated by eNB are counted as normal releases from RAN perspective as they are not real drops resulted from any radio quality problems. 
5) In denominator of the formula normal E-RAB releases due to successful HO to eHRPD are not counted.
6) The LTE_5705d KPI may provide higher values compared to reality in case in the network environment there is an Ericsson MME used when the ERAB_REL_HO_PART counter is erroneously pegged when E-RABs are not admitted with a cause successful-handover, but in fact in the E-RABs to Release List IE of the S1AP:HANDOVER COMMAND message they were accepted by the MME.
Logical Formula: E-RAB DRCause = (abnormal E-RAB release request_x / all E-RAB releases) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
100*sum([E-RABs released due to the partial Handover regardless of the bearers QCI])
/ 
sum([Total number of released E-RABs initiated by the eNB] + [E-RABs released due to the partial Handover regardless of the bearers QCI] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Normal release by UE] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Detach procedure by UE or MME] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Radio Network Layer cause] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Other causes] + [EPC initiated E-RAB releases due to Path Switch] 
- [Temporary QCI1 E-RAB release due to overbooking timer expiry] + [Total number of released E-RABs due to successful IRAT HO to UTRAN] + [Total number of released E-RABs due to successful IRAT HO to GERAN] + [E-RAB releases due to eNB Initiated Global S1 Reset] + [E-RAB releases due to MME Initiated Global S1 Reset] + [E-RAB releases due to eNB Initiated Partial S1 Reset] + [E-RAB releases due to MME Initiated Partial S1 Reset] + [E-RAB releases due to S1 Outage])
Time Summary Levels: Total; week; weeklyBH; day; dailyBH; hour

Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Number of Signaling Connection Establishment requests rejected due to C-plane overload] + [Number of Signaling Connection Establishment requests rejected due to U-plane overload] + [Number of Signaling Connection Establishment requests rejected due to lack of PUCCH resources] + [Number of Signaling Connection Establishment requests rejected due to threshold for Maximum number of RRC connections] + [Number of Signaling Connection Establishment requests rejected due to the MME overload]) / sum([Number of Signaling Connection Establishment attempts due to MO-signaling] + [Number of Signaling Connection Establishment attempts due to MT-access] + [Number of Signaling Connection Establishment attempts due to MO-data] + [Number of Signaling Connection Establishment attempts for delay-tolerant access] + [Signaling Connection Establishment attempts for high priority calls] + [Number of Signaling Connection Establishment attempts for emergency calls])

Abbreviation: Inter Freq QCI1 HO Att
Name: E-UTRAN Inter-Frequency QCI1 HO Attempts for A3/A5 measurement-based handovers
Description: The KPI indicates the number of attempts for the inter-frequency HO with QCI1 bearers, when the source eNB sends an RRC Connection Reconfiguration message to the UE, which indicates a handover command. The KPI is defined independent of the network topology (intra eNB HO / inter eNB HO) and of the usage of measurement gaps.
Official Notes:
Only event A3/A5 radio related handovers are counted. Event A4 service-based handovers and event A4 load-based handovers are not counted (3GPP TS 36.331, TS 36.413, TS 36.423).
In the exceptional case that the target cell has not accepted the QCI1 and QCI5 bearers (the QCI5 bearer is needed for VoIP signaling) during handover preparation, the counter is not incremented.
Logical Formula: Inter Frequency QCI1 HO Attempts = (number of Inter-Frequency HO attempts with QCI1)
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: sum([Inter-frequency handover attempts for UEs with QCI1 (A3/A5 radio related handovers only)])
NetEng Features: LTE3723 - VoLTE quality triggered inter frequency mobility
NetEng Comment: When LTE3723 is activated, inter frequency HO may be additionally triggered by low Voice Quality, thus LTE3723 activation may impact this counter.

Abbreviation: Inter Frequency QCI1 HO SR
Name: E-UTRAN Inter-Frequency QCI1 HO Success Ratio for A3/A5 measurement-based handovers
Description: The KPI indicates the success ratio of the inter-frequency HO for QCI1 bearers, when the source eNB receives information that UE is successfully connected to the target cell within target eNB. The KPI is defined independent of the network topology (intra eNB HO / inter eNB HO) and of the usage of measurement gaps.
Official Notes: Only event A3/A5 radio related handovers are counted. Event A4 service-based handovers and event A4 load-based handovers are not counted (3GPP TS 36.331, TS 36.413, TS 36.423).
Logical Formula:
Inter Frequency QCI1 HO SR = (number of successful Inter-Frequency Hos with QCI1) /
(number of Inter-Frequency HO attempts with QCI1) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
100 * sum([Successful inter-frequency handover completions for UEs with QCI1 (A3/A5 radio related handovers only)]) 
/
sum ([Inter-frequency handover attempts for UEs with QCI1 (A3/A5 radio related handovers only)])

Abbreviation: SCell Config to Swapped SR
Name: Successful SCell Swap to Successful SCell Configuration Ratio
Description:
The KPI indicates the ratio of successful SCell swaps to successful SCell configurations.
It also indicates how many successful SCell configurations are being part of an SCell Swap procedure due to an A6 measurement retrieval, compared to the total number of SCell configurations in a given cell.
Official Notes: Counter CA_SCELL_SWAP_A6 used in the formula measures only SCell addition events (SCell Release reconfiguration or L1/L2 reconfiguration are omitted).
Logical Formula:
SCell Configured to Swapped Success Ratio = 100% *
sum(Number of event A6 triggered SCell swaps) /

Abbreviation: DL Spectral efficiency
Name: DL Spectral efficiency
Description: This KPI indicates how much of the user data volume is transmitted over the bandwidth of used PRBs.
Official Notes:
1. KPI gives Spectral efficiency in bits/s/Hz where ([PDCP_SDU_VOL_DL] *8/(#  of TTIs in the measurement period/1000)) represents = (PDCP SDU volume in DL[bits]/Measurement period duration [seconds]) and ( [PRB_USED_PDSCH]*180 000) /(#  of TTIs in the measurement period)) represents (averaged # of PRBs used for PDSCH * 180 000 [Hz]) in the logical formula. Used PRBs also contain SRB which do not contribute to the volume. Hence, spectral efficiency might show slightly worse values depending on the ratio of SRB to DRB.
2. This KPI shall be valid only for cells which are counting PCell UEs. This means that SCell UEs and their respective data usage in the monitored cell shall NOT be counted.
3. This KPI shall be valid for PCell and SCell data volume for Intra-side CA and Inter-side CA. This means that in the monitored cell the PDCP data volume shall be counted which is designated for the related PCell and SCell(s) for which the given PCell UE is camped.
4. This may lead to a situation that for the cells acting as SCell(s) mainly the KPI value might be decreased significantly.
5. Also in case of simultaneous LTE-NR DSS usage and CA usage it may happen that LTE may increase its PRB usage and lower down its PDCP data volume, because majority of used PRBs were given to SCell UEs, which are not counted in the PDCP volume counter.
Logical Formula:
DL Spectral efficiency =
(PDCP SDU volume in DL[bits]/Measurement period duration [seconds])/(averaged # of PRBs used for PDSCH * 180 000 [Hz])
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: Sum([PDCP SDU data volume on eUu Interface downlink]) * 8 / Sum([Number of PRBs used for PDSCH]) / 180

Abbreviation: % surpress OFDM symb micro DTX RF mod
Name: E-UTRAN Percentage of Suppressed OFDM Symbols with Micro DTX in RF Module
Description: This KPI provides the percentage of suppressed OFDM symbols with micro DTX to all transmitted symbols in RF module.
Official Notes:
1) It shall be noted that the percentage is not calculated as the number of suppressed OFDM symbols to number of all transmitted symbols taken at the end of measurement period. It is calculated in such a way that for each sample with duration of 100 ms (1400 ODFM symbols), the percentage of suppressed symbols to all transmitted symbols is calculated in RF module. The average of these percentages is then reported from the RF each 60 seconds and the final average value is then calculated from all the samples reported in this manner at the end of measurement period.
2) Note: In case Traffic Concentration / active muting pattern (LTE1891 or LTE3036) is done the counter shows RF module final decision, which may differ with the cell view (MAC-PS).
Logical Formula: PercOFDMSymbDTXRF = 100*(Number of supressed OFDM symbols) / (Number of all transmitted symbols)
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: avg([Suppressed OFDM symbols with micro DTX ratio in RF module])
Time Summary Levels: Total; week; weeklyBH; day; dailyBH; hour
Comments: 04.01.2024 - Typo in Official notes corrected. (24R2/LTE21A/Hidden). M.Goral

Logical Formula: E-RAB DR PDCP SDU VOL=(abnormal E-RAB release requests, user perspective / PDCP SDU Vol )
Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
1000000000*sum (([EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Radio Network Layer cause]+[EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Other causes] + [Released E-RABs initiated by the eNB due to Radio Link Failure] + [eNB initiated E-RAB releases due to failed Handover Completion phase at target cell] + [Released E-RABs initiated by the eNB due to other reasons])) /
sum([PDCP SDU data volume on eUu Interface uplink]+[PDCP SDU data volume on eUu Interface downlink])

sum([PDCP SDU data volume on eUu Interface uplink] + [PDCP SDU data volume on eUu Interface downlink])

Description: This KPI shows the total throughput for Ethernet-based traffic in an incoming direction. Different indicators distinguish between the Ethernet traffic at the physical interface and at the VLAN.
Official Notes: The throughput is calculated as ratio of the Ethernet volume and measurement period (i.e. not only time intervals where there is incoming ethernet data but all ones are considered).

Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
sum([rxEthernetOctets]) *8 /
(sum(MEASUREMENT_DURATION)*60)

Abbreviation: Preamble tx R 1st preamble pwr limit UEs
Name: Preamble transmission ratio within 1st preamble for power limited UEs
Description: The KPI indicates ratio of preamble transmission within 1st preamble for power limited UEs to all transmissions and retransmissions for total number of UEs.
Logical Formula: Preamble transmission ratio within 1st preamble for power limited UEs [%] = 100*(Total number of UEs with RACH success within 1st preamble transmission - Number of non-power limited UEs with RACH success within 1st preamble) / (Total number of UEs with RACH success within 1st preamble + Total number of UEs with RACH success for preamble re-transmissions)
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*(sum([Total number of UEs with RACH success after one preamble transmission]) - sum([Number of non-power limited UEs with RACH success after one preamble transmission])) / (sum([Total number of UEs with RACH success after one preamble transmission]) + sum([Total number of UEs with RACH success after preamble retransmission]))
Time Summary Levels: Total; week; weeklyBH; day; dailyBH; hour

Abbreviation: Preamble retrans R pwr limit UEs
Name: Preamble re-transmission ratio for power limited UEs
Description: The KPI indicates ratio of preamble retransmission for power limited UEs to all transmissions and retransmissions for total number of UEs.
Logical Formula: Preamble re-transmission ratio for power limited UEs [%] = 100*(Total number of UEs with RACH success for preamble re-transmissions - Number of non-power limited UEs with RACH success after preamble retransmission) / (Total number of UEs with RACH success within 1st preamble transmission + Total number of UEs with RACH success for preamble re-transmissions)
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*(sum([Total number of UEs with RACH success after preamble retransmission]) - sum([Number of non-power limited UEs with RACH success after preamble retransmission])) / (sum([Total number of UEs with RACH success after one preamble transmission]) + sum([Total number of UEs with RACH success after preamble retransmission]))
Time Summary Levels: Total; week; weeklyBH; day; dailyBH; hour

Abbreviation: Preamble tx R 1st preamble non-pwr limit UEs

Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*(sum([Number of non-power limited UEs with RACH success after one preamble transmission])) / (sum([Total number of UEs with RACH success after one preamble transmission]) + sum([Total number of UEs with RACH success after preamble retransmission]))
Time Summary Levels: Total; week; weeklyBH; day; dailyBH; hour

Abbreviation: Preamble retrans R non-pwr limit UEs

Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*(sum([Number of non-power limited UEs with RACH success after preamble retransmission])) / (sum([Total number of UEs with RACH success after one preamble transmission]) + sum([Total number of UEs with RACH success after preamble retransmission]))

Abbreviation: Tot UE RACH preamble cont collision R
Name: Total UE RACH preamble contention collision ratio
Description:
The KPI indicates the contention collision ratio of total number of UEs during
RACH procedure.
Official Notes:
1. There is no distinction between power or non-power limited UEs.
2. Both of the KPIs shall consider only UEs for which UEInformationRequest procedure was triggered (according to TS 36.331).
Logical Formula:
Total UE RACH Preamble Contention collision ratio [%] = 100*(Number of UEs with
RACH preamble contention collisions) / (Total number of UEs with RACH success
after one preamble transmission + Total number of UEs with RACH success after
preamble retransmission + Number of UEs with RACH preamble contention collisions)
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*(sum([Number of UEs with RACH preamble contention collisions])) / sum([Total number of UEs with RACH success after one preamble transmission] + [Total number of UEs with RACH success after preamble retransmission] + [Number of UEs with RACH preamble contention collisions])
Time Summary Levels: Total; week; weeklyBH; day; dailyBH; hour

Abbreviation: Tot UE RACH preamble cont-free R
Name: Total UE RACH preamble contention-free ratio
Description:
The KPI indicates the contention-free ratio of total number UEs during RACH
procedure.
Official Notes:
1. There is no distinction between power or non-power limited UEs.
2. Both of the KPIs shall consider only UEs for which UEInformationRequest procedure was triggered (according to TS 36.331).
Logical Formula: Total UE RACH Preamble Contention-free ratio [%] = 100% - Total UE RACH Preamble Contention collision ratio
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100 - 100*(sum([Number of UEs with RACH preamble contention collisions]) / sum([Total number of UEs with RACH success after one preamble transmission] + [Total number of UEs with RACH success after preamble retransmission] + [Number of UEs with RACH preamble contention collisions]))
Time Summary Levels: Total; week; weeklyBH; day; dailyBH; hour

Abbreviation: Act time dist R 0/1 sat links GNSSE
Name: Active time distribution ratio with 0 or 1 GNSSE satellite links
Description: The KPIs indicates the ratio of seconds within the collection period for 0 or 1 GNSSE satellite links that are available to whole measurement period duration.
Official Notes:
1) GNSS satellites are currently represented by GPS, GLONASS and Beidou system components.
2) GNSSE is meant by external GNSS.
Logical Formula: Active time distribution ratio with 0 or 1 GNSSE sat links = (Time within 0 or 1 GNSS usable satellites condition) / (active cell time)
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100* sum([Time within 0 or 1 GNSS usable satellites condition for external GNSS]) / sum([Denominator for RRC-connected UEs per cell])
NetEng Comment:
Good quality signal is when more than 5 satellites with good signal level are usable.
At least 4 usable satellites are required to generate synchronization signal in automatic location mode

Logical Formula: Intra eNB S1 HO to a CSG cell FR = (number of unsuccessful intra eNB S1 HOs to a CSG cell) / (number of intra eNB S1 HO attempts to a CSG cell) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Failed Intra-eNB S1-HO to CSG cell due to timer expiry]) / sum([Attempted Intra eNB S1-HO to CSG cell])
Time Summary Levels: Total; week; weeklyBH; day; dailyBH; hour

Abbreviation: S1 tot HO SR intra eNB CSG cell
Name: E-UTRAN Total S1 HO Success Ratio, intra eNB to a CSG cell
Description: This KPI describes the total intra eNB S1 HO Success Ratio to a CSG cell from S1 HO preparation start until successful S1 HO execution.
Logical Formula:
Intra tot S1 HO SR to a CSG cell =
(intra eNB S1 HO prep successes to a CSG cell) / (intra eNB S1 HO preparations to a CSG cell) * (intra eNB S1 HO successes to a CSG cell) / (intra eNB S1 HO attempts to a CSG cell) * 100%
=
(intra eNB S1 HO attempts to a CSG cell) / (intra eNB S1 HO preparations to a CSG cell) * (intra eNB S1 HO successes to a CSG cell) / (intra eNB S1 HO attempts to a CSG cell) * 100%
=
(intra eNB S1 HO successes to a CSG cell) / (intra eNB S1 HO preparations to a CSG cell) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Successful Intra eNB S1-HO to CSG cell]) / sum([Intra eNB S1 HO preparations to CSG cell])
Time Summary Levels: Total; week; weeklyBH; day; dailyBH; hour

Abbreviation: S1 HO prep SR inter eNB CSG cell

Inter S1 based HO prep SR to a CSG cell = (number of successful inter eNB S1 based HO prep to a CSG cell) / (total number of inter eNB S1 based HO preparations to a CSG cell) * 100%
= (number of inter eNB S1 based HO attempts to a CSG cell) / (total number of inter eNB S1 based HO preparations to a CSG cell) * 100%

Abbreviation: % alloc 40ms CQI rep period
Name: Percentage of allocations for 40 ms CQI reporting periodicity.
Description: The KPI provides the ratio of the number of allocations for 40 ms CQI reporting periodicity to total number of allocations (40 and 80 ms CQI reporting periodicity).
Official Notes: With the shorter (40 ms) CQI periodicity the eNodeB has more accurate information of the downlink conditions each UE has. This allows the eNodeB to provide better inputs to the scheduling algorithm and select the best choice of MCS as well as power to transmit.
Logical Formula: PerAl40msCQI = (Number of allocations for 40 ms CQI reporting periodicity) / (Number of allocations for 40 ms CQI reporting periodicity + Number of allocations for 80 ms CQI reporting periodicity)) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Allocation of 40 ms CQI reporting periodicity on PUCCH]) / sum([Allocation of 40 ms CQI reporting periodicity on PUCCH] + [Allocation of 80 ms CQI reporting periodicity on PUCCH])

Abbreviation: E-RAB QCI2 DR, RAN view
Name: E-UTRAN E-RAB QCI2 Drop Ratio, RAN View
Description: This KPI describes the ratio of abnormally released (dropped) QCI2 E-RABs from RAN point of view.
Official Notes:
1. Each QCI2 bearer of the "Bearer to be Released List" IE is counted.
2. RAN point of view means that as abnormal E-RAB drops only those ones initiated by eNB are counted.
3. In the denominator of the formula normal and abnormal E-RAB releases except the successful intra LTE and inter RAT HO are counted.
4. QCI2 E-RAB releases due to S1 RESET are not counted at all.
Logical Formula: E-RAB QCI2 DR RAN = (abnormal QCI2 E-RAB releases from RAN point of view / all QCI2 E-RAB releases) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
100*sum([QCI2 E-RABs released due to the partial Handover] + [Total number of released QCI2 E-RABs initiated by the eNB] - [eNB initiated QCI2 E-RAB releases due to user inactivity] - [eNB initiated QCI2 E-RAB releases due to redirect to another cell] - [eNB initiated QCI2 E-RAB releases due to "Radio Network Layer Cause - Radio resources not available"])
/
sum([Total number of released QCI2 E-RABs initiated by the eNB] + [QCI2 E-RABs released due to the partial Handover] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests for QCI2 due to Normal release by UE] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests for QCI2 due to Detach procedure by UE or MME] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests per QCI2 due to Radio Network Layer cause] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests for QCI2 due to Other causes] + [EPC initiated QCI2 E-RAB releases due to Path Switch])
Time Summary Levels: Total; week; weeklyBH; day; dailyBH; hour

Abbreviation: Temp QCI1 stp succ to tot QCI1 stp att
Name: Temporary QCI1 bearer setup successes to total number of QCI1 bearer setup attempts ratio
Description:
The KPI describes the ratio of Temporary QCI1 bearer setup successes to the total number of QCI1 bearer setup attempts used to setup the E-RAB between MME and UE for QCI1 DRBs.
It indicates the E-UTRAN contribution to network accessibility for the end-user, not the whole end-to-end service accessibility.
Logical Formula: E-RAB SSR QCI1 = (E-RAB setup successes QCI1 / E-RAB setup attempts QCI1) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Temporary QCI1 E-RAB setup completion due to RAC overbooking] + [Temporary QCI1 E-RAB setup completion due to TAC overbooking]) / sum([Number of setup attempts for initial E-RABs of QCI1] + [Setup attempts for additional E-RABs of QCI1])
Time Summary Levels: Total; week; weeklyBH; day; dailyBH; hour

Abbreviation: Temp QCI1 stp succ to tot QCI1 stp att
Name: Temporary QCI1 bearer setup successes to total number of QCI1 bearer setup attempts ratio
Description: The KPI describes the ratio of Temporary QCI1 bearer setup successes to the total number of QCI1 bearer setup attempts used to setup the E-RAB between MME and UE for QCI1 DRBs.It indicates the E-UTRAN contribution to network accessibility for the end-user, not the whole end-to-end service accessibility.
Official Notes: The setup retry attempts related to additional E-RABs of QCI1 that failed due to ongoing mobility event and also the first setup attempts that failed due to ongoing mobility event  but were followed finally by successful RLF recovery via X2 or S1 (when setup procedure according to 3GPP TS 23.401 shall be done again in target cell) are removed from the denominator of the formula and only first attempts perceived by end user are counted.
Logical Formula: E-RAB SSR QCI1 = (E-RAB setup successes QCI1 / E-RAB setup attempts QCI1) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Temporary QCI1 E-RAB setup completion due to RAC overbooking] + [Temporary QCI1 E-RAB setup completion due to TAC overbooking]) / sum([Number of setup attempts for initial E-RABs of QCI1] + [Setup attempts for additional E-RABs of QCI1 excluding MME retries] - [Setup attempts for additional E-RABs of QCI1 aborted, followed by successful X2/S1 HO or RLF recovery over X2])
Time Summary Levels: Month; monthBH; week; weekBH; day; dayBH; hour; raw

Abbreviation: AC trigg SRVCC HO UTRAN QCI1 SR

Official Notes: This KPI is not triggered by Load Balancing cases to UTRAN.
Logical Formula: Inter RAT HO UTRAN SRVCC for QCI1 due to overbooking SR = (number of successful inter RAT HO to UTRAN with SRVCC of a temp admitted QCI1 bearer due to overbooking) / (number of inter RAT HO attempts to UTRAN with SRVCC of a temp admitted QCI1 bearer due to overbooking) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Inter System Handover successes with SRVCC due to overbooking]) / sum([Inter System Handover attempts with SRVCC due to overbooking])
Time Summary Levels: Total; week; weeklyBH; day; dailyBH; hour

Abbreviation: Inter X2 based HO prep FR OTH
Name: E-UTRAN HO Preparation Failure Ratio per Cause, inter eNB X2 based, not supported QCI failure (QCI)
Description: This KPI describes the ratio of a specific inter eNB X2 based handover preparation failure cause related to total number of inter eNB X2 based HO preparations. The source eNB fails to prepare resources for the handover to a neighboring cell in a target eNB.
Official Notes: Only handover due to radio reasons is relevant to this KPI, that is why handover preparation LB failures due to AC are subtracted from total number of handover preparations. Abbreviation: E-RAB DR, S1 Reset cause initiated by MME
Name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Drop Ratio per Cause S1 Reset initiated by MME
Description: This KPI describes the ratio of a specific E-RAB drop (abnormal release) cause related to all E-RAB releases. Cause: E-RAB drop ratio due to S1 Reset cause initiated by MME.
Official Notes:
1. Each bearer of the "Bearer to be Released List" IE is counted. 
2. There is an overlapping in the abnormal E-RABs counted within the LTE_5090f and LTE_5570g but from network planning and optimization point of view it is mandatory to have also an own indicator dealing with active E-RAB drops with data in the buffer only.
3. The formula LTE_5571f is needed to monitor the VoIP Call Drop Ratio.
4. E-RAB releases due to S1 RESET are not counted at all in the LTE_5571f.
5. E-RAB releases due to "No Radio Resources Available" initiated by eNB are counted as normal releases from RAN perspective as they are not real drops resulted from any radio quality problems.

Logical Formula: E-RAB DRCause = (abnormal E-RAB release request_x / all E-RAB releases) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
100*sum([E-RAB releases due to MME Initiated Global S1 Reset] + [E-RAB releases due to MME Initiated Partial S1 Reset])
/

Description: This KPI provides the IP throughput on non-GBR E-RABs in downlink (transferred by the PDCP layer) for 4CC CA UEs with three SCells activated.
Official Notes:
Measured according to 3GPP TS 36.314 except that the counting is done only for 4CC CA UEs with three SCells activated. The throughput the KPI provides is averaged throughput per UE and nonGBR E-RAB. Concerning the single TTI bursts fraction of TTIs are counted within the throughput time according to 3GPP TS 36.314.
Conctribution of the remote X2 SCell(s) for UEs with inter-site CA activated is covered within the KPI.
Burst duration relevant for denominator of the KPI is measured based on new method according to LTE5625.
Logical Formula: IPThrDLnonGBR CA 4CCnew  = (DL nonGBR IP throughput Data Volume for UEs with 4CC CAnew) / (DL nonGBR IP throughput time for UEs with 4CC CAnew)
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: sum([DL nonGBR IP throughput Data Volume for UEs with 4CC CA] + [DL nonGBR IP throughput Data Volume for single TTI bursts of UEs with 4CC CA]*1000) / sum([DL nonGBR IP throughput time for UEs with 4CC CA] + [DL nonGBR IP throughput time for single TTI bursts of UEs with 4CC CA]/100)
Time Summary Levels: Month; monthBH; week; weekBH; day; dayBH; hour; raw
Comments: 21.04.2023 - Rejection date added for Jump export purposes. M.Goral

Abbreviation: Init ERAB access Cat-M UEs
Name: E-UTRAN Initial E-RAB Accessibility for Cat-M UEs
Description: This KPI shows the eNB (radio part) observed probability to set up an end to end connection for Cat-M UEs. Under the end to end a connection to be provided with an initial E-RAB at request is meant.
Official Notes:
1) For those E-RABs that were temporarily admitted by the eNB and later were released due to overbooking timer expiry are excluded from the nominator, because they were never used to hand the call over to UTRAN.
2) During ICS procedure, multiple E-RABs can be established, which is counted within ERAB_INI_SETUP counters.
3) There is also a possibility to perform additional E-RABs procedure, but it is currently not possible to measure.
Logical Formula:
Init E-RAB ACSS Cat-M =
RRCConnEstSuccRate * UE LOGS1 Succ rate * InitialE-RABSetupSuccRate * 100 %
Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
100*(sum([Signaling Connection Establishment completions for LTE-M]) / sum([Signaling Connection Establishment attempts for LTE-M])) * (sum([S1 Signaling Connection Establishment completions per LTE-M UE]) / sum([S1 Signaling Connection Establishment attempts per LTE-M UE])) *
(sum([Successfully established initial E-RABs for LTE-M]) / sum([Setup attempts for initial E-RABs for LTE-M]))

/

Abbreviation: Addit ERAB access Cat-M Ues
Name: E-UTRAN Additional E-RAB Accessibility for Cat-M UEs
Description: This KPI shows the eNB (radio part) observed probability to set up an end to end connection for Cat-M UEs. Under the end to end a connection to be provided with an additional E-RAB at request is meant.
Official Notes:
1) For those E-RABs that were temporarily admitted by the eNB and later were released due to overbooking timer expiry are excluded from the nominator, because they were never used to hand the call over to UTRAN.
2) During ICS procedure, multiple E-RABs can be established, which is counted within ERAB_INI_SETUP counters.
3) There is also a possibility to perform additional E-RABs procedure, but it is currently not possible to measure.
Logical Formula:
Add E-RAB ACSS=
RRCConnEstSuccRate * UE LOGS1 Succ rate * InitialE-RABSetupSuccRate * AdditionalE-RABSetupSuccRate * 100 %
Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
100*(sum([Signaling Connection Establishment completions for LTE-M]) / sum([Signaling Connection Establishment attempts for LTE-M])) * (sum([S1 Signaling Connection Establishment completions per LTE-M UE]) / sum([S1 Signaling Connection Establishment attempts per LTE-M UE])) *
(sum([Successfully established initial E-RABs for LTE-M]) / sum([Setup attempts for initial E-RABs for LTE-M])) *
(sum([Number of successfully established additional E-RABs for LTE-M]) / sum([Number of setup attempts for additional E-RABs for LTE-M]))

Name: E-UTRAN Additional E-RAB Accessibility for Cat-M UEs

Logical Formula: Add E-RAB ACSS=RRCConnEstSuccRate * UE LOGS1 Succ rate * InitialE-RABSetupSuccRate * AdditionalE-RABSetupSuccRate * 100 %
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*(sum([Successful Signaling Connection Establishment for LTE-M]) / sum([Signaling Connection Establishment attempts for LTE-M])) * (sum([Successful S1 Signaling Connection Establishment per LTE-M UE]) / sum([S1 Signaling Connection Establishment attempts per LTE-M UE])) *(sum([Successfully established initial E-RABs for LTE-M]) / sum([Setup attempts for initial E-RABs for LTE-M])) *(sum([Number of successfully established additional E-RABs for LTE-M]) / sum([Number of setup attempts for additional E-RABs for LTE-M]))

Abbreviation: Avg RRC conn Cat-M UEs CE 0
Name: E-UTRAN Average RRC Connected Cat-M UEs selected for CE level 0
Description: This KPI shows the average number of Cat-M UEs having one SRB during the measurement period for CE level 0. The decision whether UE meets CE level 0 requirements is based on measured RSRP level compared by given thresholds (rsrp-ThresholdsPrachInfoList). CE level 0 is perceived as a good radio condition option.
Official Notes:
1. eNB will get UE's CE-level according to UE's preamble index, because different signature range corresponds to different coverage enhancement level.
2. If parameter numCELevelCatM is set to '1', it means that all UEs should be in CE level 0. In other words, this KPI should be equal to LTE_6207a.
Logical Formula: ACT Cat-M UE Area CE0 = (average number of RRC connected Cat-M UEs CE0)
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: sum([Number of RRC Connected Cat-M UEs per cell for CE level 0]) / sum([Denominator for RRC Connected LTE-M UEs per cell])

Abbreviation: Avg RRC conn Cat-M UEs CE 1

The decision whether UE meets CE level 1 requirements is based on measured RSRP level compared by given thresholds (rsrp-ThresholdsPrachInfoList). CE level 1 is perceived as a worse radio condition option compared to CE level 0.
Official Notes:
1. eNB will get UE's CE-level according to UE's preamble index, because different signature range corresponds to different coverage enhancement level.
2. If parameter numCELevelCatM is set to '1', it means that all UEs should be in CE level 0. In other words, this KPI should be equal to zero.

Summarisation Formula with NE Name: sum([Number of RRC Connected Cat-M UEs per cell for CE level 1]) / sum([Denominator for RRC Connected LTE-M UEs per cell])

Abbreviation: Tot RRC conn reestab SR Cat-M Ues
Name: Total E-UTRAN RRC Connection Re-establishment Success Ratio for Cat-M UEs
Description: The KPI shows the setup success ratio for the procedure "RRC connection re-establishment" for Cat-M UEs. Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Number of successful RRC Connection Re-establishment procedures for LTE-M]) / sum([Number of RRC Connection Reestablishment attempts for LTE-M])
