Abbreviation: Tot RRC conn reestab rej R Cat-M
Name: Total E-UTRAN RRC Connection Re-establishment rejection Ratio for Cat-M UEs
Description: The KPI shows the setup rejection ratio for the procedure "RRC connection re-establishment" for Cat-M UEs. This happens if a Cat-M UE is not allowed to do RRC connection re-establishment for example due to reconfiguration error, during E-RAB release or setup.
Official Notes: HandoverFailure cause code is rejected each time when received due to missing respective mobility features, but still it is possible due to other vendor equipment in the network, which can support it.Reestablishment is only possible to the source cell.
Logical Formula: RRC REEST RejR CatM = (RRC connection re-establishment rejections CatM / RRC connection re-establishment attempts CatM) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Rejected RRC Connection re-establishments for LTE-M]) / sum([Number of RRC Connection Reestablishment attempts for LTE-M])

Abbreviation: Tot RRC conn reestab FR Cat-M
Name: Total E-UTRAN RRC Connection Re-establishment failure Ratio for Cat-M UEs
Description: The KPI shows the setup failure ratio for the procedure "RRC connection re-establishment" for Cat-M UEs. This happens if a Cat-M UE is allowed to do RRC connection but from any reason the procedure is not completed (i.e. RRC connection re-establishment complete message is not received from MS or RRC connection release complete is sent).
Official Notes: Since RRC connection re-establishment failures calculated in an indirect way the KPI can sometimes provide negative values especially for cells with failures close to zero. This is due to fact that attempts is counted in one while successful and rejected RRC connection re-establishment may be counted in the next measurement period. HandoverFailure cause code is rejected each time when received due to missing respective mobility features, but still it is possible due to other vendor equipment in the network, which can support it. Re-establishment is only possible to the source cell.
Logical Formula: RRC REEST FailR CatM = (RRC connection re-establishment attempts CatM - RRC connection re-establishment completions CatM - RRC connection re-establishment rejections CatM) / (RRC connection re-establsishment attempts CatM) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Number of RRC Connection Reestablishment attempts for LTE-M]- [Number of successful RRC Connection Re-establishment procedures for LTE-M] - [Rejected RRC Connection re-establishments for LTE-M]) / sum([Number of RRC Connection Reestablishment attempts for LTE-M])

Abbreviation: Init ERAB stp SR high pwr UEs

Official Notes: High Power UE is one that has Power Class 1 or 2 capability.
Logical Formula: E-RAB ISSR HPW= (Initial E-RAB setup successes(high high power UEs) / Initial E-RAB setup attempts(high power UEs)) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Setup successes for initial E-RABs of High Power UEs]) / sum([Setup attempts for initial E-RABs of High Power UEs])

Abbreviation: ERAN norm rel EU pov high pwr Ues
Name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Normal Release Ratio User Perspective for High Power UEs
Description: This KPI describes the ratio of normally released E-RABs from user perspective for high power UEs. This KPI is corresponding to a Connection Completion Ratio.
Official Notes:
1. Each bearer of the "Bearer to be Released List" IE is counted
2. E-RAB releases due to No Radio Resources Available initiated by eNB are counted as abnormal releases from user perspective.
3. E-RAB releases due to double S1 which are counted within the ERAB_REL_DOUBLE_S1_H_PWR_UE are considered as normal releases from end user perspective. Typical scenario such a case may happen is  when a session is ongoing, UE  losses synchronization and send RRC reestablishment on an unprepared target cell which will send RRC reestablishment rejection to UE. UE will go to idle state and send new RRC request on target cell. When MME receives service request via target cell, it will already have UE context from source cell  (T_RLF still not expired at source cell) so will send UE context release command (RNL UE connectivity lost cause).
4. In both numerator and denominator of the formula normal E-RAB releases due to successful HO to eHRPD are not counted. 
5. High Power UE is one that has Power Class 1 or 2 capability.
Logical Formula: E-RAB NRR UP HPW= (normal E-RAB releases user perspective for high power UEs / all E-RAB releases for high power UEs) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([E-RABs Normal releases for High Power UEs] + [E-RABs Releases due to double S1 detected for High Power UEs]) / sum([E-RABs Normal releases for High Power UEs] + [E-RABs All Abnormal releases for High Power UEs])

Abbreviation: ERAB rel R rado rsrc not avail high pwr Ues

Description: This KPI shows the ratio of the released E-RABs due to Radio resources not available to all E-RAB releases for high power UEs.
Official Notes:
1. The E-RAB releases due to Radio resources not available do not represent any real radio quality problems because major reason is preemption but from NPO point of view it is important to monitor their ratio to all E-RAB releases.
2. In denominator of the formula normal E-RAB releases due to successful HO to eHRPD are not counted.
3. High Power UE is one that has Power Class 1 or 2 capability.
Logical Formula: E-RAB Rel RRNA Ratio HPW= (E-RAB Releases due to resources not available) / all E-RAB releases) * 100
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([E-RABs Releases due to Radio Resources Not Available]) / sum([E-RABs Normal releases for High Power UEs] + [E-RABs All Abnormal releases for High Power UEs])

Abbreviation: Intra-cell HO att CA reason
Name: Intra-cell handover Attempts for CA reasons
Description: This KPI indicates the number of attempted intra-cell handovers for CA reasons. Intra-cell handover is triggered to achieve higher CA capacity (more available band combinations).
Official Notes: This KPI is tied with the beginning of execution phase of a handover, e.g. an internal eNB decision is made to start handover via RRC Connection Reconfiguration message. This also means that it is a RAN view indicator, rather than a UE view (because it may contain defects before sending RRC Connection Reconfiguration message to the UE).
Logical Formula: Intra-cell HO for CA
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: sum([Number of Intra-cell Handover Attempts for CA reasons])

Abbreviation: Intra-cell HO SR CA reason

This also means that it is a RAN view indicator, rather than a UE view (because it may contain defects before sending RRC Connection Reconfiguration message to the UE).
Logical Formula: Intra-cell HO for CA SR = Succ / Att
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Number of Successful Intra-cell Handover Completions for CA reasons]) / sum([Number of Intra-cell Handover Attempts for CA reasons])

Abbreviation: Cat M dist R DL singl HARQ proc
Name: Cat-M Distribution Ratio of DL single HARQ process
Description: This KPI indicates the Cat-M distribution ratio of DL single HARQ process and the sum of all Cat-M DL HARQ processes.
Official Notes:

Logical Formula: Cat-M Distr Ratio of DL 1st HARQ = DL 1st HARQ / (DL 1st HARQ + DL 2nd HARQ + DL 3rd HARQ + DL 4th HARQ + DL 5th HARQ + DL 6th HARQ + DL 7th HARQ + DL 8th HARQ)
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Number of DL transmissions for the Cat-M UEs on the first HARQ process ID] - [Number of DL transmissions for the Cat-M UEs on the second HARQ process ID]) / sum([Number of DL transmissions for the Cat-M UEs on the first HARQ process ID])

Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Number of UL transmissions for the Cat-M UEs on the second HARQ process ID] - [Number of UL transmissions for the Cat-M UEs on the third HARQ process ID]) / sum([Number of UL transmissions for the Cat-M UEs on the first HARQ process ID])

Abbreviation: VoLTE DR RNL UE loss init eNB

Description: This KPI describes the ratio of a specific VoLTE E-RAB drop (abnormal release) cause related to all VoLTE E-RAB releases for Cat-M UEs.
Official Notes:
1. Each bearer of the 'Bearer to be Released List' IE is counted.

When MME receives service request via target cell, it will already have UE context from source cell (T_RLF still not expired at source cell) so will send UE context release command (RNL UE connectivity lost cause).

100*sum([Total number of eNB initiated E-RAB releases due to loss of connection to the UE for VoLTE (LTE-M)]) / 
sum([Total number of released E-RABs initiated by the eNB for VoLTE (LTE-M)] + [VoLTE E-RAB Releases due to the partial handover for LTE-M] + [Total number of EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Normal release by UE for VoLTE (LTE-M)] + [Total number of EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Detach procedure by UE or MME for VoLTE (LTE-M)] + [Total number of EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Radio Network Layer cause for VoLTE (LTE-M)] + [Total number of EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Other causes for VoLTE (LTE-M)] + [EPC initiated VoLTE E-RAB releases due to the Path Switch] + [VoLTE E-RAB Releases due to the timer TX2RELOCcomp expiry at target eNB via RRC Connection Release for LTE-M.] + [Number of E-RAB releases due to eNB Initiated Global S1 Reset for VoLTE (LTE-M)] + [Number of E-RAB releases due to MME Initiated Global S1 Reset for VoLTE (LTE-M)] + [Number of E-RAB releases due to eNB Initiated Partial S1 Reset for VoLTE (LTE-M)] + [Number of E-RAB releases due to MME Initiated Partial S1 Reset for VoLTE (LTE-M)] + [Number of E-RAB releases due to S1 Outage for VoLTE (LTE-M)])

Abbreviation: RRC Conn Stp FR, OAM Interv
Name: E-UTRAN RRC Connection Setup Failure Ratio per Cause, RRC Connection Setup Failure Ratio due to OAM Intervention
Description: The KPI indicates the ratio of a specific RRC connection setup failure cause to all RRC connection requests.
Official Notes:
1. The LTE_5590c provides total RRC Connection Setup Rejection ratio while the LTE_5707a covers only RRC Connection Setup Rejections due to control and user plane and MME overload, lack of PUCCH resources and the case when threshold for maximum number of RRC connections is reached, and LTE_5249a covers RRC Connection Setup Rejections due to C-Plane pool limit is exceeded. The LTE_6120a is used to find out some issues in margin settings used to start PUCCH area expansion before resources for PUCCH are running out.
2. The number of RRC Connection Setup Successes due to other and mo voice cause are treated as mo data cause, and are incremented in SIGN_CONN_ESTAB_SUCC_MO_D counter.
Logical Formula: S1 SFR = (RRC connection setup failure_x / RRC connection requests) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Number of Signaling Connection Establishment requests rejected due to OAM intervention]) / sum([Number of Signaling Connection Establishment attempts due to MO-signaling] + [Number of Signaling Connection Establishment attempts due to MT-access] + [Number of Signaling Connection Establishment attempts due to MO-data] + [Number of Signaling Connection Establishment attempts for delay-tolerant access] + [Signaling Connection Establishment attempts for high priority calls] + [Number of Signaling Connection Establishment attempts for emergency calls] + [Number of Signaling Connection Establishment attempts due to MO-voice call] + [Number of Signaling Connection Establishment attempts due to other reasons])

Abbreviation: Emerg E-RAB DR UP Cat-M UEs
Name: Emergency E-RAB Drop Ratio, User Perspective for Cat-M UEs
Description: This KPI describes the ratio of abnormally released (dropped) emergency E-RABs from user perspective point of view for Cat-M UEs.
Official Notes: Each bearer of the 'Bearer to be Released List' IE is counted. User perspective means that, as abnormal E-RAB releases, the releases initiated by eNB and EPC are counted. E-RAB releases due to 'No Radio Resources Available' initiated by eNB are counted as abnormal releases from user perspective. All Initial and Additional E-RABs are being counted within Retainability KPIs.E-RAB releases due to double S1 for Cat-M UEs which are counted within the ERAB_REL_DS1_LTEM are considered as normal releases from end user perspective. Typical scenario such a case may happen is when VoLTE call (a session in general) is ongoing, UE losses synchronization and send RRC reestablishment on an unprepared target cell which will send RRC reestablishment rejection to UE. UE will go to idle state and send new RRC request on target cell. When MME receives service request via target cell, it will already have UE context from source cell (T_RLF still not expired at source cell) so will send UE context release command (RNL UE connectivity lost cause).
Logical Formula: Emcy E-RAB NRR UP = (abnormal E-RAB releases user perspective / all E-RAB releases) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100* sum([VoLTE E-RABs Abnormal releases for IMS emergency session]) / sum([VoLTE E-RABs Abnormal releases for IMS emergency session] + [VoLTE E-RABs Normal releases for IMS emergency session])
Time Summary Levels: Month; monthBH; week; weekBH; day; dayBH; hour; raw
Comments: 22.12.2023 - Typos in Official notes corrected. (24R2/LTE18A/Hidden). M.Goral

All Initial and Additional E-RABs are being counted within Retainability KPIs.
Logical Formula: Emcy E-RAB NRR UP = (normal emcy E-RAB releases user perspective / all emcy E-RAB releases) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100* sum([VoLTE E-RABs Normal releases for IMS emergency session]) / sum([VoLTE E-RABs Abnormal releases for IMS emergency session] + [VoLTE E-RABs Normal releases for IMS emergency session])

2. There is an overlapping in the abnormal E-RABs counted within the LTE_5090d and LTE_5570e but from network planning and optimization point of view it is mandatory to have also an own indicator dealing with active E-RAB drops with data in the buffer only.

/

100*sum([E-RAB releases due to eNB Initiated Global S1 Reset] + [E-RAB releases due to eNB Initiated Partial S1 Reset] + [E-RAB releases due to S1 Outage])
/ 
sum([Total number of released E-RABs initiated by the eNB] + [E-RABs released due to the partial Handover regardless of the bearers QCI] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Normal release by UE] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Detach procedure by UE or MME] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Radio Network Layer cause] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Other causes] + [EPC initiated E-RAB releases due to Path Switch]

Abbreviation: ERAB DR Cat-M UEs cause RNL UE loss init eNB
Name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Drop Ratio per Cause for Cat-M UEs, E-RAB drop ratio due to radio network layer (RNL) due to loss of connection to the UE cause initiated by eNB
Description: This KPI describes the ratio of a specific E-RAB drop (abnormal release) cause related to all E-RAB releases for Cat-M UEs.
Official Notes:
1. Each bearer of the "Bearer to be Released List" IE is counted. 
2. E-RAB releases due to "No Radio Resources Available" initiated by eNB are counted as normal releases from RAN perspective as they are not real drops resulted from any radio quality problems.
3. All Initial and Additional E-RABs are being counted within Retainability KPIs.
4. E-RAB releases due to double S1 for Cat-M UEs  which are counted within the ERAB_REL_DS1_LTEM are considered as normal releases from end user perspective. Typical scenario such a case may happen is  when VoLTE call (a session in general)  is ongoing, UE  losses synchronization and send RRC reestablishment on an unprepared target cell which will send RRC reestablishment rejection to UE. UE will go to idle state and send new RRC request on target cell. When MME receives service request via target cell, it will already have UE context from source cell  (T_RLF still not expired at source cell) so will send UE context release command (RNL UE connectivity lost cause).
Logical Formula: E-RAB DRCause Cat-M = (abnormal E-RAB release request_x / all E-RAB releases) * 100%

Abbreviation: NB IoT UL Res NonAnchor Util R
Name: E-UTRAN UL Resource Utilization Ratio for NB-IoT UEs of Non-anchor Carriers
Description: The KPI shows the ratio of the used UL resources and available resources of concurrent non-anchor carriers given in the number of one ms intervals assigned for NB-IoT UEs in the observation period.
Official Notes:
1) This KPI is intended for capacity monitoring meaning that if current NB-IoT non-anchor carriers reach certain threshold a new carrier may be needed.

Logical Formula: NB IoT UL Res NonAnchor UtilR = 100*(Used UL resources for NB IoT UEs of non-anchor carrier ) /(48*number of one ms intervals assigned for NB IoT UEs of non-anchor carrier)
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Used NB-IoT UL resources on all UL non-anchor carriers.]) / (48*sum([Total number of one millisecond intervals reserved for NB-IoT UEs on UL non-anchor carriers]))

Abbreviation: E-RAB DR, RNL RIF ini eNB
Name: E-UTRAN E-RAB drop ratio due "RNL Failure in the Radio Interface Procedure" cause initiated by eNB
Description: This KPI describes the ratio of a specific E-RAB drop (abnormal release) cause related to all E-RAB releases. Cause "RNL Failure in the Radio Interface Procedure" cause initiated by eNB
Official Notes:
1.	Each bearer of the "Bearer to be Released List" IE is counted. 
2.	There is an overlapping in the abnormal E-RABs counted within the LTE_5090f and LTE_5570g but from network planning and optimization point of view it is mandatory to have also an own indicator dealing with active E-RAB drops with data in the buffer only.
3.	The formula LTE_5571f is needed to monitor the VoIP Call Drop Ratio.
4.	E-RAB releases due to pre-emption initiated by eNB are counted as normal releases from RAN perspective as they are not real drops resulted from any radio quality problems. 
5.	In denominator of the formula normal E-RAB releases due to successful HO to eHRPD are not counted.
Logical Formula: E-RAB DRCause = (abnormal E-RAB release request_x / all E-RAB releases) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
100*sum([eNB initiated E-RAB release - "RNL Failure in the Radio Interface Procedure"]) /
sum([Total number of released E-RABs initiated by the eNB] + [E-RABs released due to the partial Handover regardless of the bearers QCI] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Normal release by UE] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Detach procedure by UE or MME] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Radio Network Layer cause] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Other causes] + [EPC initiated E-RAB releases due to Path Switch] - [Temporary QCI1 E-RAB release due to overbooking timer expiry] + [Total number of released E-RABs due to successful IRAT HO to UTRAN] + [Total number of released E-RABs due to successful IRAT HO to GERAN] + [E-RAB releases due to eNB Initiated Global S1 Reset] + [E-RAB releases due to MME Initiated Global S1 Reset] + [E-RAB releases due to eNB Initiated Partial S1 Reset] + [E-RAB releases due to MME Initiated Partial S1 Reset] + [E-RAB releases due to S1 Outage])
Time Summary Levels: Month; monthBH; week; weekBH; day; dayBH; hour; raw

Abbreviation: Norm SgNB RR
Name: E-UTRAN Normal Release Ratio per EN-DC UE Context
Description: This KPI indicates E-UTRAN Normal Release Ratio per EN-DC UE Context.
Official Notes: 1. In case LTE5348 is enabled the successful intra-LTE handovers shall be excluded from counting with the following note: X2AP: SgNB Release Request message sent from the source MeNB to the SgNB with RNL:MCG Mobility cause for the SCG split bearers when IE UE Context Kept Indicator was included in the previously HoRequestACK message received from target MeNB, and HO was successfully completed.2. The Inter-eNB X2 HO with EN-DC keeping counters (SGNB_REL_TMENB_HO_X2_CNC and SGNB_REL_TMENB_HO_X2_PR_F) are subtracted from the denominator in order to avoid double counting of the same release which may happen on the source side and it is for the source MeNB to decide whether EN-DC connectivity shall be released or not.3. Counter SGNB_ABN_REL_TMENB_HO_X2_EX_F shall not be subtracted from SGNB_TOT_REL_INIT_MENB, because from the source MeNB the handover was successful and shall not be counted on the source side, which means it is up to target MeNB to decide to release the EN-DC connection or not.
Logical Formula: Norm SgNB RR = (SgNB norm rel init SgNB + SgNB norm rel init MeNB) / (SgNB tot rel init SgNB + SgNB tot rel init MeNB)
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Number of Normal SgNB Releases initiated by SgNB due to the user inactivity reasons] + [Number of Normal SgNB Releases initiated by MeNB due to the NAS causes: 'normal release' and 'detach'] + [Number of SgNB Releases initiated by MeNB due to VoLTE setup]) / sum([Total Number of SgNB Releases initiated by SgNB] + [Total number of SgNB Releases initiated by MeNB] + [Number of SN initiated abnormal SgNB Releases due to the X2 Partial Reset procedure] + [Number of MN initiated abnormal SgNB Releases due to the X2 Full Reset procedure] + [Number of SN initiated abnormal SgNB Releases due to the X2 Full Reset procedure] - [SgNB Releases on the  target MeNB after Inter-MeNB X2 Handover with EN-DC keeping procedure is cancelled] - [SgNB Releases on the target MeNB after Inter-MeNB X2 Handover Preparation with EN-DC keeping procedure is failed])
Time Summary Levels: Month; monthBH; week; weekBH; day; dayBH; hour; raw

Abbreviation: Norm SgNB RR
Name: E-UTRAN Normal Release Ratio per EN-DC UE Context
Description: This KPI indicates E-UTRAN Normal Release Ratio per EN-DC UE Context.
Official Notes:
1. In case LTE5348 is enabled the successful intra-LTE handovers shall be excluded from counting with the following note: X2AP: 'SgNB Release Request message sent from the source MeNB to the SgNB with 'RNL:MCG Mobility' cause for the SCG split bearers when IE 'UE Context Kept Indicator' was included in the previously HoRequestACK message received from target MeNB, and HO was successfully completed'.
2. The Inter-eNB X2 HO with EN-DC keeping counters (SGNB_REL_TMENB_HO_X2_CNC and SGNB_REL_TMENB_HO_X2_PR_F) are subtracted from the denominator in order to avoid double counting of the same release which may happen on the source side and it is for the source MeNB to decide whether EN-DC connectivity shall be released or not.
3. Counter SGNB_ABN_REL_TMENB_HO_X2_EX_F shall not be subtracted from SGNB_TOT_REL_INIT_MENB, because from the source MeNB the handover was successful and shall not be counted on the source side, which means it is up to target MeNB to decide to release the EN-DC connection or not.
4. With CB007163 enabled, the handovers can be started, for a UE with EN-DC connection, to the preferred EN-DC anchor layer where NR coverage is not guaranteed. CB007163 also modifies distribution of EN-DC UEs between layers which may result in change (lower or increase) of amount of other type of handovers like coverage from EN-DC anchor to non EN-DC or EN-DC non anchor layers. This means such handover mobility scenarios are perceived as abnormal release from end-user perspective, as the EN-DC connection will not be sustained in same/other eNB.

Abbreviation: Norm SCG Rel R exc access
Name: E-UTRAN SCG split bearer Normal Release Ratio excluding accessibility issues
Description: This KPI indicates SCG split bearer Normal Release Ratio excluding accessibility issues, which may happen during SgNB Addition and SgNB Modification procedures. The ratio is described by SCG split bearer normal releases divided by total number of SCG split bearer releases excluding accessibility issues.
Official Notes: If S1AP: UE Context Release Command with any Cause is initiated by any trigger listed in UESTATE.2917, after X2AP: SgNB Addition Request and before S1AP: E-RAB ModificationConfirm, procedure is terminated and EN-DC UE Connection Release(LTE_CP_91002) is performed.MN Initiated SgNB Release is not started if SgNB replies with SgNB Addition Request Reject.SCG_NOR_REL_INIT_MENB_NAS may be also increased during SgNB Addition procedure, but currently there is no separate counter to subtract accessibility issues tied with this use case.If during the SgNB Modification procedure there will be an issue with timer expiry or inconsistency of Ack message which will result in a failure then the all SCG NR-PDCP split bearers shall be released via SgNB Release procedure. The MeNB shall keep the bearers as MCG and release all resources reserved for bearer type change procedure.If during the SgNB Modification procedure there will be an issue with either Reject or Partial Admission, then MeNB will not initiate SgNB Release.
Logical Formula: Norm SCG RR = (SCG norm rel init SgNB + SCG norm rel init MeNB) / (SCG tot rel init SgNB + SCG tot rel init MeNB - SCG rel init MeNB due to accessibility issues)
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Number of SCG split bearers for Normal SgNB Releases initiated by SgNB due to the user inactivity reasons] + [Number of SCG split bearers for Normal SgNB Releases initiated by MeNB due to the NAS causes: 'normal release' and 'detach']) / sum([Total Number of SCG split bearers for SgNB Releases initiated by SgNB] + [Total number of SCG split bearers for SgNB Releases initiated by MeNB] + [Number of SCG split bearers for SN initiated abnormal SgNB Releases due to the X2 Partial Reset procedure] - ([Number of SCG split bearers for preparation attempts during SgNB Addition procedure] - [Number of SCG split bearers for preparation failures during SgNB Addition due to rejection from SgNB] - [Number of SCG split bearers for completion attempts during SgNB Addition]) - ([Number of SCG split bearers during MeNB Initiated SgNB Modification attempts for addition of new bearers] - [Number of SCG split bearers during MeNB Initiated SgNB Modification completion successes for addition of new bearers] - [Number of SCG split bearers during MeNB Initiated SgNB Modification failures for addition of new bearers]))

Abbreviation: E-RAB ARR High Pwr UEs
Name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Abnormal Release Ratio for High Power UEs

Official Notes: The E-RAB releases due to Radio resources not available do not represent any real radio quality problems because major reason is preemption but from NPO point of view it is important to monitor their ratio to all E-RAB releases.In denominator of the formula normal E-RAB releases due to successful HO to eHRPD are not counted.High Power UE is one that has Power Class 1 or 2 capability.
Logical Formula: E-RAB ARR High Pwr UEs = (abnormal E-RAB releases high pwr UEs / all E-RAB releases high pwr UEs) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([E-RABs All Abnormal releases for High Power UEs] - [E-RABs Releases due to double S1 detected for High Power UEs]) / sum([E-RABs All Abnormal releases for High Power UEs] + [E-RABs Normal releases for High Power UEs])

Abbreviation: E-RAB DR, TA lim reach
Name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Drop Ratio per Cause, E-RAB drop ratio due to E-UTRAN generated reason - Timing Advance limit reached cause initiated by eNB
Description: This KPI describes the ratio of a specific E-RAB drop (abnormal release) cause related to all E-RAB releases.
Official Notes:
1.Each bearer of the "Bearer to be Released List" IE is counted. 
2.There is an overlapping in the abnormal E-RABs counted within the LTE_5090f and LTE_5570g but from network planning and optimization point of view it is mandatory to have also an own indicator dealing with active E-RAB drops with data in the buffer only.
3.The formula LTE_5571f is needed to monitor the VoIP Call Drop Ratio.

Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
100*
sum([eNB initiated E-RAB releases due to Timing Advance limit reached]) 
/ 
sum([Total number of released E-RABs initiated by the eNB] + [E-RABs released due to the partial Handover regardless of the bearers QCI] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Normal release by UE] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Detach procedure by UE or MME] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Radio Network Layer cause] 
+ [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Other causes] + [EPC initiated E-RAB releases due to Path Switch] - [Temporary QCI1 E-RAB release due to overbooking timer expiry] + [Total number of released E-RABs due to successful IRAT HO to UTRAN] + [Total number of released E-RABs due to successful IRAT HO to GERAN] 
+ [E-RAB releases due to eNB Initiated Global S1 Reset] + [E-RAB releases due to MME Initiated Global S1 Reset] + [E-RAB releases due to eNB Initiated Partial S1 Reset] + [E-RAB releases due to MME Initiated Partial S1 Reset] + [E-RAB releases due to S1 Outage])

Description: The KPI shows the ratio of the used UL resources and available resources of concurrent 1st non-anchor carrier given in the number of one ms intervals assigned for NB IoT UEs in the observation period on this carrier.
Official Notes: Used resources are evaluated as sum of subcarriers (granularity of 3.75 kHz) used for scheduling of the NB IoT UEs from all one ms intervals assigned for NB IoT UEs from the observation period.
Logical Formula: NB IoT UL Res 1st NonAnchor UtilR = 100*(Used UL resources for NB IoT UEs of 1st non-anchor carrier ) /(48*number of one ms intervals assigned for NB IoT UEs of 1st non-anchor carrier)
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Used NB-IoT resources on the first UL non-anchor carrier]) / (48*sum([Total number of one millisecond intervals reserved for NB-IoT UEs on the first UL non-anchor carrier]))
Time Summary Levels: Month; monthBH; week; weekBH; day; dayBH; hour; raw

Abbreviation: DL IP sch tput excl MAC retx
Name: IP scheduled throughput excluding the MAC retention delay in DL per profile
Description: This KPI measures the IP scheduled throughput in DL in PMQAP framework with an exclusion of MAC layer retransmissions (HARQ NACK received).
Official Notes: 1. This KPI is created for the purpose of comparison with other vendors which use the logic of time counting without retransmissions in MAC layer, which is not in line with end-user experience. This means that during burst length duration it may happen that one or more of the MAC TBs needs to be retransmitted which in result may greatly extend the counted time, despite the fact global PDCP buffer has been already emptied. Nokia assumes that the time spent for HARQ retransmission after the buffer has been emptied (after the burst has ended) is naturally perceived by the end-user as a degradation in throughput due to low radio channel quality.
Logical Formula: DL IP sch tput excl MAC retx = PDCP SDU data volume sent in DL / the time spent in PDCP buffer excluding retx in MAC layer in DL
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: sum([IP Throughput data volume in DL per Profile]) / sum([IP Throughput time in DL excluding MAC layer retention delay per Profile])
Time Summary Levels: Month; monthBH; week; weekBH; day; dayBH; hour; raw

Abbreviation: E-RAB norm Rel R EPC init
Name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Normal Release Ratio User Perspective
Description: This KPI describes the ratio of normally released E-RABs from user perspective. This KPI is corresponding to a Connection Completion Ratio.
Official Notes:
1) Each bearer of the Bearer to be Released List IE is counted.
2) E-RAB releases due to No Radio Resources Available initiated by eNB are counted as abnormal releases from user perspective.
3) E-RAB releases due to double S1 which are counted within the ERAB_REL_DOUBLE_S1 are considered as normal releases from end user perspective. Typical scenario such a case may happen is when VoLTE call (a session in general) is ongoing, UE losses synchronization and send RRC reestablishment on an unprepared target cell which will send RRC reestablishment rejection to UE. UE will go to idle state and send new RRC request on target cell. When MME receives service request in Initial UE message via target cell followed by sending Initial Context setup Request message to eNB, the MME will already have UE context from source cell (T_RLF still not expired at source cell) so will send UE context release command (RNL UE connectivity lost cause). The E-RABs that are re-established in target cell via sending Initial Context setup response message to MME are then not perceived in source cell as abnormal but as normal releases from end user perspective.
4) In relation to previous point the KPI may have an error in the networks with degraded LTE_5112c.  
5) It shall be noted that RNL UE connectivity lost cause is generated for double S1 only by fALU MME. The MME from Cisco and Nokia vendors generate NAS: normal cause for double S1 which means directly contributing to normal releases. The Ericsson MME generates RNL E-UTRAN Generated reason cause for double S1 which is currently not counted within any dedicated counter. Due to this fact the KPI may provide higher values comparing to reality for the network with Ericsson MME. In general, regarding the networks with MME from other vendors than fALU there can be an error as well in case the RNL UE connectivity lost cause generated for some other scenarios than double S1.
6) In both numerator and denominator of the formula normal E-RAB releases due to successful HO to eHRPD are not counted.
7) The KPI may provide slightly less values compared to reality in case in the network environment there is an Ericsson MME used when the ERAB_REL_HO_PART counter is erroneously pegged when E-RABs are not admitted with a cause successful-handover, but in fact in the E-RABs to Release List IE of the S1AP:HANDOVER COMMAND message they were accepted by the MME.
Logical Formula: E-RAB NRR UP = (normal E-RAB releases user perspective / all E-RAB releases) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
100*sum([eNB initiated E-RAB releases due to user inactivity] + [eNB initiated E-RAB releases due to redirect to another cell] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Normal release by UE] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Detach procedure by UE or MME] + [Total number of released E-RABs due to successful IRAT HO to UTRAN] + [Total number of released E-RABs due to successful IRAT HO to GERAN] + [E-RAB releases due to double S1 detected])
/
sum([Total number of released E-RABs initiated by the eNB] + [E-RABs released due to the partial Handover regardless of the bearers QCI] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Normal release by UE] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Detach procedure by UE or MME] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Radio Network Layer cause] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Other causes] + [EPC initiated E-RAB releases due to Path Switch] - [Temporary QCI1 E-RAB release due to overbooking timer expiry] + [Total number of released E-RABs due to successful IRAT HO to UTRAN] + [Total number of released E-RABs due to successful IRAT HO to GERAN] + [E-RAB releases due to eNB Initiated Global S1 Reset] + [E-RAB releases due to MME Initiated Global S1 Reset] + [E-RAB releases due to eNB Initiated Partial S1 Reset] + [E-RAB releases due to MME Initiated Partial S1 Reset] + [E-RAB releases due to S1 Outage])
Time Summary Levels: Total; week; weeklyBH; day; dailyBH; hour

Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
100*sum([EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Radio Network Layer cause]+[EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Other causes] +
[Released E-RABs initiated by the eNB due to Radio Link Failure]+[eNB initiated E-RAB releases due to failed Handover Completion phase at target cell]+ [Released E-RABs initiated by the eNB due to other reasons]) /
sum([EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Normal release by UE]+[EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Detach procedure by UE or MME]+[EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Radio Network Layer cause]+ [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Other causes] + [Released E-RABs initiated by the eNB due to Redirect]+ [Released E-RABs initiated by the eNB due to User Inactivity] + [Released E-RABs initiated by the eNB due to Radio Link Failure] +[eNB initiated E-RAB releases due to failed Handover Completion phase at target cell] +[Released E-RABs initiated by the eNB due to other reasons] + [Pre-empted GBR bearers] + [Pre-empted non-GBR bearers])
Formula Notes:
1. Each bearer of the "Bearer to be Released List" IE is counted
2. User perspective point of view means that as abnormal E-RAB drops both those ones initiated by eNB and EPC are counted.
3. E-RAB releases due to "No Radio Resources Available" initiated by eNB are counted as normal releases as they are not real drops resulted from any radio quality problems.
4. The PRE_EMPT_GBR_BEARER and PRE_EMPT_NON_GBR_BEARER counters provide the total number of released GBR and non GBR E-RABs due to "Radio resources not available" despite a pre-emption used in the counter names, respectively.
5. In the denominator of the formula normal and abnormal E-RAB releases except the successful intra LTE and inter RAT HO are counted.
6. E-RAB releases due to S1 RESET are not counted at all.

Abbreviation: E-RAB DR Activ RNL
Name: E-UTRAN E-RAB active drop ratio with data in the buffer due to RNL Radio Connection with UE Lost
Description: This KPI indicates the ratio of a specific E-RAB drop (abnormal release) cause to all E-RAB releases. Cause: E-RAB active drop ratio with data in the buffer due to RNL radio connection with a UE lost cause initiated by an eNB.
Official Notes:
1. Each bearer of the "Bearer to be Released List" IE is counted.
2. There is an overlapping in the abnormal E-RABs counted within the LTE_5090d and LTE_5570e but from network planning and optimization point of view it is mandatory to have also an own indicator dealing with active E-RAB drops with data in the buffer only.
3. The formula LTE_5571d is needed to monitor the VoIP Call Drop Ratio.
4. In the denominator of the formula normal and abnormal E-RAB releases except the successful intra LTE and inter RAT HO are counted.
5. E-RAB releases due to S1 RESET are not counted at all.
6. E-RAB releases due to "No Radio Resources Available" initiated by eNB are counted as normal releases as they are not real drops resulted from any radio quality problems.
7. Inter RAT HO to GERAN is excluded from counting on ERAB_REL_HO_PART and ERAB_REL_HO_PART_QCI1 because it is not certain whether the MME will include the E-RAB with QCI#1 into the "E-RABs to Release List". So the restriction is not only in eNB side but also in EPC side.
Logical Formula: E-RAB DRCause = (abnormal E-RAB release request_x / all E-RAB releases) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name:
100*sum([Released active E-RABs QCI1] + [Released active E-RABs QCI2] + [Released active E-RABs QCI3] + [Released active E-RABs QCI4] + [Released active non GBR E-RABs (QCI5...9)]) /
sum([Total number of released E-RABs initiated by the eNB] + [E-RABs released due to the partial Handover regardless of the bearers QCI] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Normal release by UE] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Detach procedure by UE or MME] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Radio Network Layer cause] + [EPC initiated EPS Bearer Release requests due to Other causes] + [EPC initiated E-RAB releases due to Path Switch])

Abbreviation: UL Spectral efficiency
Name: UL Spectral efficiency
Description: This KPI gives info how much user data volume is received over bandwidth of used PRBs.
Official Notes:
1) KPI gives Spectral efficiency in bits/s/Hz where ([PDCP_SDU_VOL_UL] *8/(# of TTIs in the measurement period/1000)) represents = (PDCP SDU volume in UL[bits] / Measurement period duration [seconds]) and ([PRB_USED_PUSCH]*180 000) /(# of TTIs in the measurement period)) represents (averaged # of PRBs used for PUSCH * 180 000 [Hz]) in the logical formula. Used PRBs also contain SRB which do not contribute to the volume. Hence, spectral efficiency might show slightly worse values depending on the ratio of SRB to DRB.
2) This KPI shall be valid only for cells which are counting PCell UEs. This means that SCell UEs and their respective data usage in the monitored cell shall NOT be counted.
3) This KPI shall be valid for PCell and SCell data volume for Intra-site CA and Inter-site CA. This means that in the monitored cell the PDCP data volume shall be counted which is designated for the related PCell and SCell(s) for which the given PCell UE is camped.
4) This may lead to a situation that for the cells acting as SCell(s) mainly the KPI value might be decreased significantly.
5) Also in case of simultaneous LTE-NR DSS usage and CA usage it may happen that LTE may increase its PRB usage and lower down its PDCP data volume, because majority of used PRBs were given to SCell UEs, which are not counted in the PDCP volume counter.
6) In case of EN-DC usage the PDCP_PDU_X2_DL_SCG counter is added in order properly reflect Dual Carrier scenarios from data volume perspective. It must be noted that there is a small difference between SDU and PDU packet type, where SDU is closer to end-user experience because it does not contain overhead from PDCP layer.
Logical Formula:
UL Spectral efficiency = 
(PDCP SDU volume in UL[bits]/Measurement period duration [seconds])/(averaged # of PRBs used for PUSCH * 180 000 [Hz])
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: Sum([PDCP SDU data volume on eUu Interface uplink] + [Number of NR PDCP PDU data volume sent on X2 interface from eNB for SCG split bearers]) *8 / Sum([Number of PRBs used for PUSCH]) / 180
Time Summary Levels: Month; monthBH; week; weekBH; day; dayBH; hour; raw

Abbreviation: Perc alloc 40ms CQI rep period

Logical Formula: RCC Con SSR NB IoT mtAccess CE1= (RRC connection setup completions with cause mt-Access for NB IOT UEs CE1 / RRC connection requests with cause mt-Access for NB IoT UES CE1) * 100%
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Successful RRC Connection Establishments with cause "mt-Access" for NB-IoT UEs, which selected coverage enhancement level 1 during random access]) / sum([Attempted RRC Connection Establishments with cause "mt-Access" for NB-IoT UEs, which selected coverage enhancement level 1 during random access])

Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Unsuccessful RRC Connection Establishment due to cell rejection for NB-IoT UEs which selected coverage enhancement level 2 during random access])/ sum([Attempted RRC Connection Establishment for NB-IoT UEs with coverage enhancement level 2])

Abbreviation: Inter-eNB X2 HO with ENDC keeping tot SR
Name: E-UTRAN Inter-eNB X2 HO with EN-DC keeping total success ratio
Description: This KPI indicates the total success ratio of Inter-eNB X2 HO with EN-DC keeping, which is given by ratio of X2AP: SgNB Reconfiguration Complete message to X2AP: SgNB Addition Request message.
Official Notes: The Inter-eNB X2 handover with EN-DC keeping procedure is preceded by SgNB Modification procedure which prepares SgNB with information that target eNB shall try to perform SgNB Addition for the requested EN-DC UE.
Logical Formula: Inter-eNB X2 HO with ENDC keeping tot SR = (SgNB Reconfiguration Complete message during inter-MeNB HO X2) / (Inter-eNB X2 HO with ENDC keeping prep att)
Summarisation Formula with NE Name: 100*sum([Number of sent SgNB Reconfiguration Complete message during inter-MeNB HO X2]) / sum([Number of sent SgNB Addition Request message during inter-MeNB HO X2])
Time Summary Levels: Month; monthBH; week; weekBH; day; dayBH; hour; raw
